Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://wevote.us

* Fraud and phishing warning * 

Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you

*About WeVote*
WeVote is a 100% volunteer-powered, nonpartisan nonprofit that uses technology to help voters make informed decisions. With 250+ active volunteers and a national reach—we prove grassroots, mission-first civic tech can have real impact.

Join the WeVote Movement

WeVote has an open volunteer position for a Newsletter Team Co-Lead, for 2 hours or more per week. You are an experienced professional with a passion for helping America navigate our current political environment. This is an opportunity to work remotely with our active team to help us get ready for multiple upcoming elections. Our ideal volunteer is passionate about politics and excited to use technology to educate voters and increase voter turnout. You’ll also gain valuable technical skills, have opportunities for leadership development, and expand your personal and professional network.

About Us

WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 180 active passionate, part-time volunteers (starting with the founders) who build mobile technologies that will touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We believe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a positive voting experience that helps people decide how to vote. More information at https://WeVote.US or @WeVote on X.

What You'll Do

  • Assemble, edit, and get reviewed our regular newsletter (in Mailchimp). We send a public newsletter approximately once per month to ~5,000 subscribers, and an internal newsletter once per month to ~1,200 current and former volunteers
  • Work with our 15+ person marketing team, including graphic artists, writers, videographers, and political data managers
  • Inspire other volunteers to craft text, photos, and images for the newsletter
  • Work within WeVote content guidelines, leverage our existing assets (Canva), and create new assets

Who you are: Must haves.

  • You want to work with an established and successful team. You are committed to strengthening American Democracy.
  • You are striving for personal excellence, and want to do meaningful work that will make a difference.
  • 2+ hours per week during our core team hours M-F 8 a.m. - 6 p.m.
  • A willingness to work with and support other volunteers.
  • You agree with WeVote’s Core Values.
  • We are seeking a marketing perfectionist; someone who loves the iteration process, someone who strives for artistry in their deliverables.

How to apply:

Submit your resume (at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply/) and include a brief note/cover letter to why you are interested in WeVote and helping our mission.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-newsletter-team-co-lead

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/newsletter-team-co-lead-wevote

data.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Position Summary

McKesson Corporation is seeking talented Software Developer to join our Supply Chain Technology team with a strong background in microservices architecture, system integrations, CP4D, Apache Kafka, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). This role is ideal for someone with 4+ years of hands-on development experience who thrives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, intelligent systems that power modern enterprise applications and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using modern frameworks and cloud-native technologies.

  • Design and implement real-time data streaming solutions using Apache Kafka.

  • Build robust integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, messaging queues, and middleware.

  • Collaborate with AI/ML teams to embed intelligent features into applications, including predictive analytics, NLP, and automation.

  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines using CP4D.

  • Write and optimize SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers in Oracle.

  • Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability of distributed systems.

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and CI/CD.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems, ensuring uptime and responsiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.

Critical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS).

  • Proficient in ETL development, Oracle performance tuning, and complex SQL.

  • Deep understanding of Apache Kafka for event-driven and real-time data processing.

  • Experience implementing AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in teams

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in healthcare or supply chain domain.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge of API gateways, service mesh, and observability tools.

  • Experience with MLOps and deploying AI models in production environments.

  • Certifications in cloud, Kafka, or AI technologies.

  • Exposure to data engineering and big data tools (e.g., Spark, Flink).

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

About MMS

McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers.

Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private-label medical-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID-19 tests.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

$103,500 - $172,500

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: .

McKesson is an Equal Opportunity Employer

McKesson provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other legally protected category. For additional information on McKesson’s full Equal Employment Opportunity policies, visit our Equal Employment Opportunity page.

McKesson is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) or (Canada) . Resumes or CVs submitted to this email box will not be accepted.

data.title: Cyber Hunt Team Leader (R-00256)
data.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Cyber Hunt Team Lead to oversee proactive threat hunting operations, advanced threat detection, and adversary analysis within complex federal environments. This leadership position is responsible for directing threat hunting missions, developing sophisticated detection methodologies, and coordinating with Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), and government teams to identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on cybersecurity experience, strong technical leadership capabilities, and deep expertise in threat hunting, endpoint and network security monitoring, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and advanced threat detection engineering.

Job Responsibilities

    Job Responsibilities

    • Proactive Threat Hunting & Team Leadership: Lead and coordinate enterprise threat hunting missions, directing proactive investigations, advanced security analytics, and hypothesis-driven hunting activities to identify sophisticated cyber threats and previously undetected malicious activity across federal systems.
    • Advanced Threat Detection & Adversary Analysis: Analyze adversary behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging threats, including advanced persistent threats (APTs), to identify potential compromises, uncover security weaknesses, and develop actionable recommendations to strengthen enterprise defenses.
    • Cross-Functional Security Collaboration: Coordinate with SOC analysts, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) teams, cybersecurity business partners, and government stakeholders to investigate threats, share intelligence, validate findings, and support coordinated detection and mitigation efforts.
    • Threat Hypothesis Development & Detection Engineering: Develop and refine threat hunting hypotheses, behavioral analytics, detection logic, and security monitoring use cases to improve the identification of malicious activity across endpoint, network, and enterprise security environments.
    • Threat Intelligence & Indicator Management: Establish and maintain a centralized knowledge base of indicators of compromise (IOCs), adversary TTPs, threat hunting findings, and detection methodologies to support repeatable investigations, intelligence sharing, and continuous improvement of security operations.
    • Purple Team Exercises & Threat Emulation: Support and lead collaborative Purple Team exercises and adversary emulation activities to assess security detection capabilities, simulate realistic attack techniques, identify monitoring gaps, and recommend enhancements to defensive controls.
    • Security Framework Alignment & Continuous Improvement: Leverage MITRE ATT&CK and recognized threat hunting methodologies to map adversary techniques, evaluate detection coverage, improve hunting procedures, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to threat hunting and security operations personnel.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

    • Cybersecurity & Threat Hunting Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including hands-on threat hunting, security monitoring, incident investigation, threat detection, or related defensive security disciplines within complex enterprise environments.
    • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
    • Threat Detection Technologies & Security Frameworks: Demonstrated hands-on experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Network Detection and Response (NDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary emulation techniques, including developing and executing advanced threat hunting methodologies.
    • Operating Systems, Networking & Adversary Techniques: Strong technical understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, enterprise networking, network protocols, endpoint security, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with the ability to analyze sophisticated attack activity across enterprise infrastructure.
    • Technical Leadership & Threat Intelligence Collaboration: Proven ability to lead threat hunting initiatives, develop threat hypotheses and detection logic, coordinate complex security investigations, and collaborate with SOC, CTI, engineering, and government stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate advanced cybersecurity threats.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/cyber-hunt-team-leader-r-00256-true-zero-technologies

data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role

HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.

What you will do

• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
reproducible and version controlled.
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
how it behaves there.
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
has to be preserved.
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match

the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
tools from day one.
Where you need depth
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
and defend.
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
to be shipped.
Where working knowledge is enough
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
containers.
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
monitoring and alerting.
Across everything
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
and careful, staged rollout.
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
written.
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
with your counterparts rather than around them.

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the

domain to the right engineer.

• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

Recruitment Notice

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

Protect yourself by following these steps:

  • Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
  • Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
  • If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/platform-engineer-ai-banyan-software

Position Purpose: Implements, engineers, and maintains enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) systems and solutions. Performs administration, configuration, integration, and maintenance of authentication platforms, services, infrastructure, and policies to support secure and reliable access across enterprise applications and platforms. Designs, builds, tests, and maintains scalable and stable authentication solutions to meet business and security requirements. Leads and collaborates with cross-functional teams through the implementation and operational lifecycle of authentication technologies.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

  • Creates, implements, and maintains policies, configurations, and procedures related to MFA, authentication, identity verification, and passwordless technologies using IAM security best practices.
  • Engineers, administers, and supports enterprise authentication platforms, including Cisco Duo, Axiad, PingOne Verify, and emerging passwordless solutions such as Windows Hello.
  • Manages and maintains supporting infrastructure, servers, integrations, and services to ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and security of authentication solutions.
  • Analyzes, designs, develops, implements, and supports authentication integrations and identity-related solutions across enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Creates and maintains accurate technical documentation, architecture designs, configurations, operational procedures, and support processes.
  • Collaborates with IAM Architecture, PAM, SSO, Azure, Information Security, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to deliver end-to-end authentication solutions.
  • Participates in project initiatives, technical implementations, change controls, and cross-functional deliverables to support IAM and enterprise security strategies.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves complex, escalated Tier 3 incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent solutions to prevent recurrence.
  • Participates in on-call rotations and provides operational support for business-critical authentication services.
  • Contributes to the development and implementation of IAM and MFA technical strategies, standards, and procedures, including identity verification, passwordless authentication, and emerging AI agent identity and access monitoring capabilities.
  • Supports coding, scripting, automation, configuration, testing, and documentation of developments within the authentication landscape.
  • Ensures compliance with corporate policies and procedures, ethical practices, security standards, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and Requires 4 – 6 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Technical Skills:

  • Experience with Active Directory, Cisco Duo, Axiad, Ping Identity, Okta, or other MFA and authentication platforms.
  • Knowledge of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication protocols, identity verification, and passwordless technologies.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Computing Security and enterprise identity integrations.
  • Knowledge of Identity as a Service (IDaaS) solutions.
  • Experience with server administration, infrastructure support, troubleshooting, scripting, and automation is preferred.
  • Experience supporting production environments, incident management, and change management processes is preferred.

Soft Skills:

  • Intermediate - Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty.
  • Intermediate - Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Intermediate - Ability to work independently.
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure.
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills.

License/Certification:

  • Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM) preferred.
  • Certified Identity and Security Technologist (CIST) preferred.
  • Certified Access Management Specialist (CAMS) preferred.
  • Relevant IAM, cybersecurity, cloud security, or Microsoft security certifications preferred.

Pay Range: $87,000.00 - $161,300.00 per year

data.title: Principal Thermal Systems Engineer, Data Center Liquid Cooling (Industry Expert)
data.description:
This is a remote position.

Be Part Of A High-Performing Team

Join a global climate technology organization developing advanced thermal solutions for high-density data centers and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. This team operates at the intersection of mechanical engineering, liquid cooling, controls, system integration, and product commercialization.

The organization is expanding its data center capabilities to support next-generation computing environments with reliable, scalable, and energy-efficient cooling architectures. Team members collaborate with engineering leaders, product teams, customers, consultants, and industry organizations to transform emerging technologies into practical commercial solutions.

This opportunity is designed for an experienced data center thermal professional who can bring immediate technical credibility, influence system direction, and communicate effectively with customers and senior stakeholders.

What s In Store For You

  • A highly visible role supporting advanced data center cooling initiatives
  • The opportunity to influence next-generation liquid cooling architectures
  • Remote flexibility for highly qualified candidates
  • Collaboration with senior engineering, product, commercial, and customer teams
  • Participation in industry associations, technical committees, conferences, and standards development
  • Exposure to system design, simulation, validation, commissioning, and commercialization
  • Opportunities to mentor technical professionals and shape long-term engineering strategy
  • Comprehensive health, retirement, family-building, educational, wellness, and paid-time-off programs
  • Travel support for qualified candidates attending onsite interviews in Davidson, North Carolina

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for advanced data center thermal management and liquid cooling systems.
  • Develop integrated cooling concepts spanning chips, racks, coolant distribution units, facility water systems, controls, and heat rejection.
  • Evaluate system architectures, equipment capabilities, operating modes, control strategies, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Perform or guide thermal analysis, computational fluid dynamics, modeling, simulation, and equipment evaluation.
  • Develop system documentation, piping concepts, mode tables, control requirements, and sequences of operation.
  • Support system validation through digital analysis, laboratory testing, commissioning, and field evaluation.
  • Collaborate with product teams, technical specialists, consultants, customers, and commercial leaders.
  • Provide technical guidance during strategic customer pursuits and system commercialization efforts.
  • Deliver technical presentations to customers, leadership teams, sales organizations, and industry audiences.
  • Participate in organizations such as ASHRAE, the Open Compute Project, IEEE, or other relevant standards groups.
  • Translate emerging cooling technologies into reliable, scalable, and market-ready solutions.

Do You Have the Expertise to Lead in Data Center Thermal Systems?

  • Bachelor s degree in mechanical engineering, thermal sciences, controls engineering, or a closely related discipline.

data.description:
Headquarters: United States

About RHONDOS

RHONDOS is the recognized leader in SAP security and observability — trusted by Fortune 500 and Fortune 2000 enterprises globally to secure and observe their most mission-critical systems. Our PowerConnect solution delivers real-time threat detection, compliance automation, and deep operational visibility across SAP environments, on market-leading platforms including Splunk, Dynatrace, and Elastic. We maintain strategic partnerships with global systems integrators, ISVs, and VARs.

We are a rapidly growing and profitable business with a lean, highly skilled team operating with a distributed team across the globe. We move fast, think strategically, and build things that last.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Director, Solutions Engineering to lead presales at RHONDOS, reporting to the President & Chief Product Officer. You will lead our sales engineering function worldwide and own how RHONDOS designs, demonstrates, and proves PowerConnect for customers and partners.

Beyond the deal cycle, you will own market research and competitive analysis, set the standards for demos and POCs, and run the feedback loop that brings what the field learns back to Product and Engineering. This role suits a presales leader who still likes being hands-on, has worked closely with product or project management, and wants to build a function at a company where that work has visible impact.

What You'll Do

•     Lead, coach, and hire sales engineers in partnership with regional GTM leaders so every region runs to the same presales standards

•     Own presales capacity and deal coverage with regional sales leaders, and track technical win rate, POC conversion, and cycle time to keep improving how the team works

•     Set the standards for technical discovery, demos, and POCs, including success criteria, timelines, and close-out reviews, and hold the team to them

•     Build and maintain demo environments, reference architectures, and solution patterns across Splunk, Cisco, Dynatrace, and other supported platforms, and lead hands-on evaluation of new platforms and technologies we could support

•     Engage directly on strategic and complex opportunities as the senior technical voice, including helping customers build the technical and business case for PowerConnect

•     Own technical responses to RFPs and architecture reviews, and maintain a reusable response library

•     Scope deployments accurately and run clean handoffs to Customer Success and Professional Services so what we sell is what gets delivered

•     Own market research and competitive analysis: track the SAP security and observability landscape, maintain competitive positioning, and equip the field to win against alternatives

•     Run the feedback loop from the field to Product and Engineering: capture customer requirements, product gaps, and win/loss themes, and bring them to roadmap discussions with clear evidence

•     Deliver technical enablement for RHONDOS sellers and for partner technical teams at Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace

•     Work with Marketing on technical messaging so solution content, launches, and competitive materials are accurate and reflect how customers actually deploy

•     Represent RHONDOS at partner and industry events such as Splunk .conf, Dynatrace Perform, and SAP community events; travel approximately 25%

Your First Year

•     First 30 days: Join live deals in every region and sit in on discovery, demos, and POCs. Get hands-on with PowerConnect and meet our key technical contacts at Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace

•     Days 31–60: Act as the senior technical voice on our top opportunities and document what is working and what isn't. Design a technical enablement program for Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace partner teams

•     Days 61–90: Turn what you've seen in live deals into a first version of demo and POC standards, and bring a presales plan into next fiscal year's planning: coverage, headcount, metrics, and targets

•     Months 4–12: Make the standards how every region works, launch partner enablement, and run the team against its annual targets, with technical win rate as the headline measure

What You Bring

Required

•     8+ years in presales, solutions engineering, or solution architecture for enterprise software, including 3+ years leading a sales engineering team

•     A track record of running demos and POCs that convert in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles

•     Strong technical grounding in enterprise observability, security analytics, or data platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Elastic

•     Working knowledge of SAP landscapes, or the technical depth to get there quickly

•     Hands-on exposure to product management or project management: requirements, roadmaps, or structured delivery

•     Experience building team standards, enablement programs, or playbooks that others adopt

•     Experience leading a distributed team across time zones

•     Clear communication with technical and executive audiences, internal and external

•     Resident in and legally authorized to work in the United States

Bonus Points

•     Presales or partner experience at Splunk, Cisco, Dynatrace, or another observability or security vendor

•     Experience selling with and through technology partners and systems integrators

•     SAP Basis, SAP security, or GRC background

•     Formal competitive intelligence or market research experience

•     Experience building a presales function at a small or scaling software company

•     Splunk, Dynatrace, or security certifications

Competitive US benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and company holidays.

We also offer:

•     A fully remote-first working environment with genuine flexibility

•     Company-provided equipment

•     Direct exposure to a global enterprise customer base and partner ecosystem

•     A small, high-caliber team where your work has immediate impact

•     Room to grow the Solutions Engineering team as the business scales

Culture

We move fast, trust each other, and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes over activity.

•     Positive Reciprocity — Mutual success with customers, partners, and each other

•     Play to Win — With discipline, clarity, and velocity

•     Customer Obsession — We are relentless about customer success

•     Do the Right Thing — Even when it's harder

This Role Is Not for Everyone

If you want a large presales organization with dedicated demo engineers, competitive analysts, and enablement staff, this probably isn't the right fit. Here you lead the team and still do the work: you will build demos, write competitive briefs, and join deals yourself. If you want to build a presales function and shape how a growing company sells, we'd like to talk.

Employment

This is a full-time, remote position employed directly by RHONDOS Inc. in the United States. Our working language is English.

Equal Opportunity

RHONDOS is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants with disabilities on request.

Data Protection

Personal data submitted is processed by RHONDOS Inc. solely for the purposes of this recruitment process. We retain application data for six months following the conclusion of the recruitment process unless the candidate consents to our keeping it longer. Candidates may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their data at any time by writing to hr@rhondos.com, including under applicable state privacy laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act.

The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.

We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Job Summary and Objective of the Position


The Application Developer will work as part of the Enterprise Delivery team under the direction of the Director of Dynamics Application Development. The position relies on experience and judgment to build, enhance, and support Dynamics 365 solutions for multiple areas of the business, requiring a broad degree of independence, knowledge, and problem-solving skills.
The Application Developer will be responsible for designing and developing new Enterprise web components in Dynamics 365 using C#, SQL, .Net, JavaScript, CRM Plugins, Azure Functions, Power Automate, Power Apps, as well as extending and supporting existing applications.

Additional responsibilities include designing and developing new applications and automations as well as extending and supporting existing solutions using the Power Platform including any of the following: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse, Power FX, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure API Management Gateway, PCF Controls, and SQL Server.

The ideal candidate will be a strong communicator, and self-starter working in an agile environment. They will require a high level of experience understanding business problems and coding technically sound solutions following industry best practices while exhibiting the ability to communicate in both a technical and non-technical or business manner, depending on the audience.  They will be pivotal in adhering to standards for application development and implementation. A familiarity with other serverless microservices, automation, and low code platforms is a plus.

This candidate will have the ability to simultaneously address, manage, and deliver multiple units of work within a given timeframe ensuring the timeline is adhered to, quality requirements are documented and followed, and acceptance criteria is met against deadlines. 
The candidate will possess strong institutional knowledge of the insurance and IT industries to craft the most effective and efficient solutions for the business. LOMA Certifications or other insurance industry knowledge preferred.

Primary Job Functions:

  • Work with business, digital agents, and IT partners to evaluate and propose solutions
  • Collaborate with business and IT leadership to develop and communicate long term vision and comprehensive strategic plans for solution architecture and delivery
  • Work with product owners, business users, and technical leads to define requirements, assess business value, and develop specifications for enterprise solutions
  • Use Agile best practice to design, develop, and maintain solutions built in enterprise applications platforms
  • Document and monitor application interfaces and architecture
  • Develop and document architecture for enterprise applications and related integrations
  • Drive standards for development and design techniques used by enterprise application teams
  • Monitor emerging trends in enterprise application platforms and determine relevance and impact 
  • Design and develop integrated business solutions that interact between multiple enterprise platforms within the cloud (Azure). 

Work Experience, Education, Certification / Training Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent certifications / experience required in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject preferred
  • 3+ years IT development experience required.  Operational and/or Incident management experience a plus
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or equivalent experience
  • Strong experience and understanding of Microsoft Power Platform with Azure Development (such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, APIM)
  • Strong experience with Dataverse (common data service) and Data modeling
  • Data migration and data integration experience will be considered as an advantage
  • Experience with other Microsoft technologies, languages, and frameworks will be considered as an advantage
  • Experience working on a project team using a waterfall and/or agile SDLC methodology required (Agile preferred)
  • Microsoft Power Platform Certification(s) will be considered as an advantage
  • Knowledge and experience in Agile Scrum methodologies
  • Experienced with development practices: code review, coding standards, continuous integration, pair programming
  • Experience in the Insurance industry and/or LOMA coursework

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Strong communication skills
  • The adaptability to work in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to think outside the box to provide innovative solutions 
  • Self-starter that can initiate research and/or contact others to solve issues Embrace the team environment and success
  • Strong aptitude to pick up new skills and knowledge through research and perseverance
  • Willingness not only to understand the technical nature of the task, but to build the subject domain knowledge around why the task is being done and how the results are being utilized by the business
  • Analytical ability required:  (give examples)
  • When presented with an issue, the ability to logically break down the problem and step through to root cause identification and subsequent resolution
  • Ability to analyze, understand and ultimately create solutions in the most efficient and effective manner when presented with requirements/tasks

data.title: Frontend Software Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of experience with deep expertise in frontend development

data.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

When a founder logs into Wayflyer, what they see, and how easily they can make sense of it, directly affects whether they trust us with their business. We're building financial products that need to feel effortless.

What you'll actually do

  • Provide technical leadership in architectural decisions and champion our existing frontend best practices, advocating for our standards and helping push them forward across the team

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features using TypeScript and React, ensuring high-quality, reusable components that scale across our financial products

  • Partner with product and design teams to shape product outcomes, defining intuitive experiences that help e-commerce brands access and manage their funding. This goes beyond delivering UI; every engineer here plays a meaningful role in what we build and how it serves our customers

  • Own end-to-end delivery: shape solutions with product/design, build and test, ship to production and monitor/iterate using our observability stack.

  • Drive improvements in performance, accessibility, and user experience across our platform

  • Mentor engineers across the team and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high quality standards

  • Work closely alongside our backend engineers, contributing across the stack when needed. We actively encourage curiosity and flexibility about where you can add value

  • Lead technical discussions and contribute to the team's technical strategy

  • Identify and proactively address technical debt and system scalability challenges

Who thrives here

You should be comfortable making and defending technical decisions, while remaining open to feedback and alternative approaches. You'll need to balance technical excellence with business needs and help guide the team toward pragmatic solutions.

You excel at stakeholder management and can effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. You're proactive in identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems. We look for candidates with most or all of the below traits that can point to real experience applying them.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of experience with deep expertise in frontend development

  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and extensive experience with React and modern frontend architectures

  • Expert knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript fundamentals with a focus on performance optimisation

  • Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and managing complex state, including hands-on experience with TanStack Query

  • Experience contributing to and working with design systems

  • Familiarity with backend technologies (Python, Django) and a willingness to contribute across the stack. This isn’t a hard requirement, but that flexibility matters to us.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (especially GitHub Actions) and maintaining high-quality testing practices using tools like Storybook/Chromatic, Playwright, and Vitest

  • Proven track record of leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems

  • Excellent communication abilities and experience managing stakeholder relationships

Given what we do, experience in financial services, fintech and business-to-business organisations is particularly interesting to us.

We hire for range

What you're like as a person and how you treat people is a big deal for us. People love working with you. You're helpful and generous with your time and knowledge. People love helping you back. People know where they stand with you.

You're always looking to learn and grow, on a personal and professional level. And you're always looking to help others learn and grow by sharing your own knowledge and experience.

You know why diversity, equality, inclusion and belonging matters, and speak up when we can do better.

What this role could turn into

Frontend engineers here tend to grow in a few different directions: shaping architecture across multiple products, moving into staff or principal engineering tracks, or stepping into engineering management. Some engineers want to go deep on the technical track; others find their strengths pull them toward leading and growing people. We support both paths, and the direction depends on where your interests are strongest.

Location and working policy

📍Fully remote, Europe.

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

The challenge

When a founder applies for funding, one flow carries them from application to money in their account - the processes that assess their business in minutes and the product experience that makes it feel effortless are all part of the same system. Our full stack engineers are the ones who can follow a feature all the way through: from the data model, to the API, to the screen a founder trusts with their business.

  • Own features end-to-end: shape solutions with product and design, build across the API and the UI, ship to production to create outcomes, not just deliver tickets

  • Lean into your specialism - whether that's backend architecture, data modelling and performance, or frontend architecture, accessibility and user experience - and act as the go-to person for it on your team

  • Design and develop backend services using Python and Django, including the data models and RESTful APIs that power our financial products

You're proactive in identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems.   • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth - we'll play to your strengths

  • Useful skills include a strong proficiency in Python and Django (or similar frameworks like FastAPI or Flask), SQL databases (preferably PostgreSQL), and API design — plus working proficiency in TypeScript and React and a real appetite to build product UI

  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (especially GitHub Actions) and a strong testing culture

  • Solid understanding of version control with Git

  • Understanding of security best practices and data protection

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent communication abilities and proven track record of successful team collaboration

Given what we do, experience in financial services, fintech and business-to-business
organisations is particularly interesting to us.

We hire for range

What you're like as a person and how you treat people is a big deal for us. People love working with you. You're helpful and generous with your time and knowledge. People love helping you back. People know where they stand with you.

You're always looking to learn and grow, on a personal and professional level. And you're always looking to help others learn and grow by sharing your own knowledge and experience.

You know why diversity, equality, inclusion and belonging matters, and speak up when we can do better.

What this role could turn into

Our engineers here grow in whichever direction their interests pull them. Some deepen their specialism and move toward staff or principal tracks in specific technologies; some stay broad and take on architecture across whole product areas; others step into engineering management. Joining as a full stack engineer doesn't mean giving up your specialism - it means choosing where to deepen it with more context.

Location and working policy

📍Remote in Europe

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

data.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Core Services Mobility Lead to oversee the architecture, engineering, operations, and support of enterprise mobility services. This individual will provide technical leadership for the mobility environment, with a primary focus on BlackBerry Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Apple device management, Microsoft Intune integration, identity services, and mobile security.

The Core Services Mobility Lead will serve as the technical authority for mobility architecture and engineering decisions, ensuring solutions align with enterprise requirements, security standards, and operational objectives. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in enterprise mobility management, Microsoft technologies, mobile device security, and technical team leadership.

Location: This position is fully remote.

Day to Day Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

  • Own the enterprise mobility architecture and approve technical changes involving identity management, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Microsoft 365, and Apple technologies.

  • Lead, mentor, and provide technical direction to the Core Services engineering team.

  • Establish engineering standards and best practices while promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as the primary technical representative for mobility services across TSA, Peraton, and external vendors.

  • Provide technical guidance and serve as the final escalation point for complex Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) issues.

Mobility Engineering and Operations

  • Lead the design, implementation, upgrades, and ongoing support of BlackBerry UEM and BlackBerry Enterprise Mobility Server (BEMS).

  • Maintain existing zero-touch iOS enrollment capabilities using Apple Business Manager (ABM), Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), and Apple Push Notification service (APNs) certificates.

  • Coordinate with End User Services (EUS) to support required Apple enrollment and certificate updates.

  • Maintain the Microsoft Intune integration, including App Protection Policies and Compliance Partner integration with UEM through Microsoft Graph. Intune supports application protection and compliance integration and is not the primary Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform.

  • Design and maintain certificate delivery solutions for mobile devices using Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) and Public Key Cryptography Standards (PKCS).

  • Identify opportunities to improve mobility services, infrastructure performance, operational efficiency, and service delivery.

Security and Compliance

  • Map Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) mobile Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to applicable mobility policies and configurations.

  • Review each new iOS release to assess security implications, compatibility, and required policy updates.

  • Ensure mobility engineering solutions align with established security requirements, enterprise policies, and applicable compliance standards.

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and operational risks affecting the mobility environment.

Infrastructure Operations and Service Delivery

  • Support the operations, maintenance, and engineering of enterprise IT infrastructure, including Microsoft Windows Server environments.

  • Ensure engineering activities align with established change, release, and configuration management processes.

  • Monitor ongoing work, resolve technical issues, and communicate operational status and risks to management.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to coordinate infrastructure and mobility activities.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or a Associates degree and 14 years of experience or a High School diploma/equivalent and 16 years of experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship, must have the ability to obtain / maintain a DHS Entrance on Duty (EOD) clearance.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting, managing, or engineering enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • 10+ years of experience with Microsoft Windows Operating Systems, serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise mobility architecture, engineering, and operations.
  • Experience with BlackBerry UEM and BEMS administration, engineering, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting Apple device management, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and APNs certificates.
  • Experience integrating Microsoft Intune with enterprise UEM solutions, including application protection and compliance management.
  • Strong understanding of identity management, PKI, and mobile device certificate delivery.
  • Experience with SCEP and/or PKCS certificate enrollment and delivery methods.
  • Knowledge of mobile security requirements and experience implementing security policies and compliance controls.
  • Strong understanding of change, release, and configuration management processes and how they interact within an enterprise IT environment.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring engineers, or leading technical teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess technical challenges, exercise sound judgment, and develop effective solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to management, customers, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a distributed team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active or previously held Public Trust or higher security clearance

  • Experience working with TSA or other federal government mobility environments.

  • Experience mapping DISA mobile STIG requirements to enterprise mobility policies and configurations.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Graph and its use in UEM and Intune integrations.

  • Experience with ServiceNow and enterprise IT service management processes.

  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools such as SolarWinds or Microsoft System Center Operations Manager (SCOM).

  • Experience supporting Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Active Directory, and account management.

  • Experience supporting iOS, Android, BlackBerry, macOS, Unix, or Linux environments.

  • Knowledge of IT security fundamentals, networking, and cloud operations.

  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

data.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Staff Software Engineer is responsible for leading a team of engineers building and designing a product that our customers and associates love. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be part of a dynamic team with engineers of all experience levels who help each other build and grow technical and leadership skills while creating, deploying, and supporting production applications. In addition, Staff Software Engineers will assist in product and tool selection, configuration, security, resilience, performance tuning and production monitoring.
Staff Software Engineers contribute to foundational code elements that can be reused as well as architectural diagrams and other product-related documentation.
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a core player on the product team and are expected to build and grow the skillsets of the more junior Engineers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 50% Delivery and Execution - Develops, tests, deploys, and maintains software, with a clear understanding of the value the software is to provide; Takes a broad view when approaching issues; using a global lens; Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances; Develops test suites (functional, destructive, etc) to enable success, rapid deployment of code to production; Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm; Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances
  • 10% Learns and Grows - Actively seeks ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels; Learns through successful and failed experiment when tackling new problems
  • 20% Plans and Aligns - Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful; Delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences; Works the Product Team to ensure user stories are developer ready, easy to understand and testable; Collaborates with other team members in agile processes; Relates openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people; Adapts approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations
  • 20% Supports and Enables - Fields questions from product and engineering teams; Helps grow junior engineers by providing guidance on modern software development frameworks, and leading technical discussions; Notes gaps on the team and provides suggestions for changes to make the team more productive

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • This position typically reports to Software Engineer Manager or Sr. Manager
  • This position typically has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements:

  • No travel required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of relevant work experience in site reliability engineering or related field
  • Proficiency in cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and infrastructure as a code (Terraform, Ansible)

Hence achieving our vision.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Senior Frontend Technical Lead — React & Integrations

Location preference: Denver, CO (Open for Remote)

Position Summary

  • We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Web Developer – React / Node.js to take ownership of web application architecture, hands-on development, and technical delivery for a high-impact web team. This is a hands-on coding role requiring deep expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express, along with the ability to guide developers, make sound architecture decisions, and deliver scalable, production-grade web applications.
  • In this role, you will lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of web applications integrated with restaurant technology ecosystems, while partnering closely with clients, product teams, IT leadership, marketing, and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of scalable web applications.

  • Identify technical gaps, challenge assumptions, guide developers, review designs and code, and make decisions based on the complete solution.
  • Assess delivery risks, manage technical dependencies, coordinate testing, and prepare applications for production releases.
  • Partner effectively with IT Directors, Product Management, Marketing, and development team members to plan roadmaps and deliver solutions.
  • Establish and promote coding standards, development best practices, architecture patterns, documentation practices, and technical guidelines.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code with a focus on consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and optimize existing applications.
  • Ensure application performance, quality, responsiveness, availability, and customer experience.
  • Monitor application performance, crashes, availability, and customer experience metrics using tools such as DataDog, Splunk, App Insights, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Support CI/CD practices and contribute to efficient release processes.
  • Develop and maintain unit testing frameworks and quality practices.
  • Apply knowledge of application security and networking to build reliable, secure solutions.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern engineering practices to support continuous innovation.
  • Bring a consulting mindset, strong client communication, and effective presentation skills to technical discussions and delivery engagements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software or web development experience, including significant experience building production-grade web applications.
  • 5+ years of recent hands-on coding experience with React.js; coding assessment will be conducted.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years in a Lead Web Developer, Tech Lead, or similar technical leadership role.
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js and Express.
  • 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring Developers and Senior Developers.
  • 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining multi-page applications in React.js.
  • Full stack familiarity, including backend technologies such as Node.js and related services.
  • Strong experience with HTML5, CSS, and CSS preprocessors such as LESS and SASS.
  • Advanced knowledge of command line build utilities and task runners such as npm, webpack, grunt, and gulp.
  • Advanced knowledge of accessibility standards.
  • Real-time working experience with asynchronous requests, API integrations, partial page updates, SEO optimization, SSR, and page performance troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of version control systems, including Git.
  • Proven experience with CI/CD practices.
  • Track record developing unit testing frameworks.
  • Competency in application security and networking.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud Functions.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and planning technical roadmaps.
  • Ability to assess risks, manage dependencies, coordinate testing, and support successful production releases.
  • Strong documentation discipline, commitment to consistency and reusability, and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Strong consulting, client communication, and presentation skills.
  • Practical judgment, attention to scope management, and a collaborative approach to solving delivery challenges.
  • Experience integrating restaurant POS platforms is a plus.

data.title: Senior Product Engineer
data.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in.

Tech environment

This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one.
  • Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them.
  • Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults.
  • Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems.
  • Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel.
  • Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms.
  • Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces.
  • Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact.

What success looks like

  • You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value.
  • You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization.
  • You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made.
  • You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives.
  • You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support.
  • You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes.

Who will thrive in this role

You will likely thrive here if:

  • You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems.
  • You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined.
  • You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane.
  • You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context.
  • You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward.
  • You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales.

Why join Fever

  • You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems.
  • You will have real ownership and visible impact.
  • You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business.
  • You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution.
  • You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible schedule
  • Bonus
  • Stock options
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance from Day 1
  • English or Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport)
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
