data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Console
data.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead of the Console team.

Deepgram is the leader in developer-friendly building blocks for language AI: real-time transcription, voice agents, and audio intelligence at scale. The Console team owns the product surfaces that help developers discover, test, and adopt Deepgram. That includes customer-facing experiences like Console and Playground, account management (authorization, billing, analytics), agentic tooling integrations like MCP servers and SDK experiences, and internal tools that support teams across the company. These surfaces shape a customer's first impression of Deepgram and directly influence buying decisions.

In the current wave of AI-native development, developer experience is the product. The best infrastructure wins by being the easiest to trust.

As a Staff engineer, you'll set the technical direction for our self-serve platform and lead large, high-priority, cross-functional projects that shape the company's product-led growth. You'll partner with senior leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Marketing, help set priorities, and anticipate the problems we'll face before they arrive. You'll still write a lot of code. We're looking for a strong full-stack generalist with broad product instincts.

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical strategy and architecture for Console, Playground, account management services, and agentic developer tooling. Make sure today's decisions scale with our product-led growth plans.

  • Lead large, high-priority, cross-functional projects from ambiguous idea to launch. Drive the key technical decisions and keep stakeholders informed at major milestones.

  • Partner with senior leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Marketing on roadmap and company direction, especially for AI-native developer experience.

  • Set priorities with the engineering manager and product leadership, and translate them into clear, incrementally releasable work for the team.

  • Build and ship full-stack features yourself, including polished user interfaces and the APIs and backend services behind them.

  • Drive the technical foundation of the self-serve growth engine: activation funnels, in-product upgrade flows, usage-based billing instrumentation, and PLG experimentation.

  • Shape how developers use Deepgram through AI tools, including MCP servers, SDK experiences, AI agent playgrounds, and LLM-powered developer tooling.

  • Spot recurring patterns in incidents, tech debt, and delivery problems. Surface root causes to leadership, anticipate future problems, and own the solutions.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the team through design reviews, code reviews, technical standards, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping full-stack web applications used by customers.

  • Experience as a technical lead on large, cross-functional projects with significant business impact.

  • Strong front-end skills with modern web technologies and frameworks, and a strong command of web fundamentals, product quality, and user experience.

  • Solid backend experience in a language such as Python, Rust, Go, or similar, including designing APIs and services for customer-facing products.

  • Proven ability to drive architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams scale.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on strategy and prioritization, and influencing without authority.

  • A habit of finding root causes, anticipating problems, and turning them into durable solutions.

  • A consistent record of mentoring engineers and raising the bar on engineering practices.

  • Comfort with startup realities: building quickly, iterating often, and running experiments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered developer tooling such as playgrounds, SDK experiences, interactive docs, or evaluation UIs for ML models.

  • Experience shipping agentic or voice AI integrations, such as MCP servers, function-calling pipelines, or voice assistant SDKs.

  • Experience driving PLG at a developer-tools company, including activation experiments, usage-based pricing, and upgrade flows.

  • Experience with React, or interest in learning it.

  • Depth in backend systems: databases (Postgres), schema design, and performance optimization at scale.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerized deployments, and hybrid cloud (bare-metal datacenters plus cloud providers).

  • Interest in Rust, LLM APIs, GPUs, and real-time audio systems, and a willingness to challenge common assumptions about where the technology is heading.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Lead Systems Engineer - Design

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices

  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

data.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, Operational AI
data.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

The Opportunity

As AI transitions from analysis into real-world autonomous action, enterprises require more than intelligent models—they need an ultra-low-latency operational fabric that connects agent swarms and workflows directly to live reality. That requires authoritative state, unified context, and enterprise-grade policy controls.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Aerospike, you will serve as the hands-on technical authority partnering with lead architects and engineering teams across Global 2000 enterprises. You will own the technical architecture and end-to-end implementation of mission-critical systems: discovering deep architectural challenges, writing core production code, validating high-throughput workloads, and driving post-production operational resilience.

This is a premier individual contributor (IC) role. You will bridge customer production deployments with Aerospike’s core product and platform engineering teams, translating novel distributed systems challenges into reusable platform patterns, hardened reference architectures, and foundational product features.

What You’ll Build

  • Authoritative State Engines: Architect and implement real-time distributed foundations for session, entity, workflow, and multi-agent state. Support massive concurrent reads/writes under stringent SLA guarantees for data freshness, consistency, and sub-millisecond recovery.
  • Context Assembly Pipelines: Design systems that merge enterprise records, streaming state, low-latency vector search, and graph topologies to provide grounded, permission-aware context for autonomous decisions.
  • Execution Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Embed deterministic boundaries, authorization checks, rate/execution governors, and human-in-the-loop triggers directly into distributed data and execution paths.
  • Auditable Governance & Traceability: Build immutable telemetry and lineage pipelines that capture runtime context, decisions, downstream side-effects, and state mutations to meet enterprise security and compliance standards.
  • The Continuous Operating Loop: Build and tune closed-loop distributed systems: State → Context → Inference → Action → Consequence → State Mutation, ensuring deterministic execution at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive System Architecture: Embed with enterprise staff/principal engineers and platform owners to break ambiguous, high-scale operational requirements into concrete systems designs, data schemas, and verifiable milestones.
  • Write Production Code: Write, optimize, and review high-performance code across Aerospike, distributed data backends, vector search runtimes, and agentic execution frameworks.
  • Own Technical Outcomes: Drive full-lifecycle validation in client staging and production environments. Troubleshoot concurrency bottlenecks, memory leaks, cluster failovers, and serialization overhead under extreme workloads.
  • Rigorous Systems Benchmarking: Design and execute performance profiles testing tail latency (p99p99p99/p99.9p99.9p99.9), throughput limits, cross-region replication lag, vector recall, and fallback reliability under active network partitions.
  • Influence Platform Roadmap: Function as the primary bridge back to internal core engineering. Extract reusable components, build field libraries and toolchains, and author standard-setting reference architectures.
  • Technical Thought Leadership: Serve as a domain expert on real-time operational AI. Present architectural trade-offs to senior client leadership, write definitive implementation guides, and mentor partner engineering teams.

How You’ll Lead (Staff/Principal IC Track)

  • Architectural Anchor: Act as the technical North Star for forward deployed engineering, setting standards for code quality, design documentation, and production readiness across high-value client projects.
  • Force Multiplier: Elevate senior and staff engineers across the team through design reviews, pair programming on complex distributed debugging sessions, and targeted technical mentorship.
  • Cross-Organizational Impact: Partner seamlessly with Product, Core Database Engineering, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture to resolve architectural misalignments and accelerate deployment velocity.
  • Domain Advocacy: Distill real-world distributed agent failure modes into technical white papers, internal technical deep dives, and open-source tooling.

Operating Model with Client & Field Teams

Principal FDEs own the architecture, direct systems implementation, and end-to-end technical integrity of Operational AI deployments.

  • Professional Services leads standard installations, migrations, cluster sizing, and infrastructure operations.
  • Solutions Architecture & TAMs maintain long-term account governance, commercial alignment, and operational advisory.
  • Your Focus: You remain unburdened by routine implementation, maintenance tickets, or account management. Your remit is solving the hardest distributed computing and operational AI problems, deploying working code, and hardening our software for enterprise-scale adoption.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience building and scaling high-performance distributed systems, database internals, or large-scale data infrastructure in production.
  • Deep Systems Programming: Proven expertise in Go, C/C++, Java, or Rust, with an understanding of memory management, lock-free data structures, networking protocols, cache hierarchies, and concurrent systems programming.
  • Real-Time Data & Systems Design: Track record of designing systems with strict SLA targets (sub-10ms tail latency, high-throughput streaming, and robust consistency models).
  • Applied AI & Agentic Infrastructure: Hands-on experience building low-latency context retrieval platforms, vector index optimizations, stateful agent runtimes, or deterministic workflow orchestration engines.
  • Distributed Governance & Security: Practical knowledge of building zero-trust data access layers, cryptographic auditing, data isolation models, and distributed rate-limiting.
  • Client-Facing Technical Leadership: Demonstrated poise and clarity when working with customer engineering leaders, with the ability to cut through ambiguity and make high-judgment technical tradeoffs on the fly.
  • Independence & Execution Bias: Self-directed operator capable of taking an abstract concept from whitepaper or sketch through to battle-tested production software.

Helpful Experience

  • Hands-on experience with the Aerospike Real-time Data Platform, Aerospike Vector Search (AVS), or Aerospike Graph.
  • Experience with distributed coordination primitives (Raft, Paxos), durable event-driven systems (Kafka, Flink), or durable execution frameworks (Temporal).
  • Familiarity with Linux kernel tuning, eBPF, zero-copy networking, or bare-metal performance optimization.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, hybrid-cloud networking, and Terraform.

Compensation and Impact

  • Evaluation Metric: Success is driven by production deployments, platform adoption, reduction of architectural debt, and high-impact software assets—never billable hours or utilization percentages.
  • Comprehensive Benefits (USA): Competitive base salary, significant equity participation, 401(k) matching, comprehensive medical/dental/vision coverage, and flexible remote work allowances.

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

While we love smart tech, we value human connection even more. AI helps us optimize the process, but real people make 100% of the actual hiring decisions.

This position is fully remote. All applicants must live and work in the United States.

TAG is seeking passionate, talented Lead CMS Developer to lead our Drupal projects and help deliver outstanding digital experiences to our clients. This is not a traditional lead role. At TAG, development is powered by our in-house, Claude-based software factory: autonomous development agents that take well-defined tickets from spec to pull request. As Lead Developer, you are the technical lead on your projects and the person responsible for those agents. You define the requirements with the client, direct the work, verify everything the agents produce, step in when they get it wrong, and ship the releases yourself. You are the most important quality checkpoint in our process. You will work on exciting projects using open-source technologies for some of the world's largest brands, in a fast-paced environment where several projects are in play at once. Becoming a TAG team member is an opportunity to grow and achieve, while working with a highly collaborative and diversely skilled team.

As a Lead CMS Developer at TAG you will...

  • Serve as the technical lead and primary technical point of contact on your CMS projects, primarily Drupal
  • Work directly with clients and project managers to gather requirements and translate them into clear specifications, acceptance criteria and development tickets
  • Own the architecture and technical direction of your projects: content modeling, module selection, integrations, performance, hosting and infrastructure

  • Review and verify everything the agents produce against requirements and TAG standards; you are the final quality checkpoint before work reaches QA and the client

data.description:
The Leidos Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO) is seeking a Network Observability Engineer; this position will allow for full time telework from any U.S. based location.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Leidos CIO Services is seeking a talented and innovative Network Observability Engineer to join our growing team within the CDAO division, which is responsible for enterprise observability and for enabling the enterprise with AI solutions. The successful candidate will engineer, operate, and continuously improve the systems that monitor the health, performance, and availability of the Leidos enterprise network, leveraging technologies such as Splunk, OpenSearch, OpenConfig, OpenTelemetry, and Machine Learning, as well as SNMP-based monitoring and NetFlow analysis. In this role, you will turn network telemetry into actionable operational intelligence, building the data pipelines, dashboards, alerts, and automation, using modern AI-assisted development tools, that help operations teams detect, troubleshoot, and resolve issues faster. You will actively participate in all phases of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, integration, testing, documentation, and implementation. Your work will align with best practices, operational excellence, and forward-thinking approaches to network observability.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with network operations, engineering teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver effective network observability solutions.
  • Onboard, normalize, and analyze network telemetry (syslog, SNMP, NetFlow, and streaming telemetry) in Splunk and OpenSearch, building searches, dashboards, alerts, and reports that provide situational awareness of network health and performance.
  • Deploy and maintain modern network telemetry solutions leveraging OpenConfig and OpenTelemetry standards.
  • Design and develop software, scripts, and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and integrate with REST APIs to collect data, enrich events, and connect monitoring platforms with other enterprise tools.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex to accelerate development of integrations, automation, and monitoring content, applying sound code review, testing, and version control practices to AI-generated code.
  • Integrate monitoring alerts and events with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms to support automated incident creation, routing, and closed-loop resolution.
  • Apply Machine Learning and AI techniques for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and event correlation to enhance network performance and reliability.
  • Utilize SNMP, NetFlow, and other monitoring techniques to maintain and optimize network performance.
  • Document procedures and maintain detailed audit-level records of systems and processes.
  • Provide tiered troubleshooting, resolution, and root-cause analysis for complex network monitoring and performance issues.
  • Engage with senior management and stakeholders as necessary to communicate technical insights and strategic recommendations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field with 4+ years of relevant industry experience; additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
  • Strong understanding of network design, protocols, and performance management, with the ability to interpret device and traffic telemetry.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and/or OpenSearch, including data onboarding, search languages (SPL, KQL/Lucene), dashboards, and alerting.
  • Hands-on experience with SNMP, NetFlow, OpenConfig, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting (Python preferred), with a track record of building automation and developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar to write, test, and maintain code.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Machine Learning techniques within network monitoring and analysis frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Aruba/Silver Peak SD-WAN and related networking technologies.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database interfaces, including ODBC.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform, and with ITIL Incident, Change, and Configuration Management practices.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with modern network monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds NPM.
  • Experience with Splunk ITSI, OpenSearch Observability, or similar AIOps and service monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for automation and monitoring code.
  • Experience with telemetry pipeline tools such as Cribl Stream or the OpenTelemetry Collector.
  • Experience building ServiceNow integrations (e.g., Event Management, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, or MID Server).
  • Exposure to SD-WAN management technologies and protocols.
  • Familiarity with IP SLA or similar synthetic monitoring tools.
  • Tessaral mesh routing.
  • Current or past certifications such as Splunk Core Certified Power User or Admin, Aruba Certified SD-WAN Professional (ACSP), Aruba Certified SD-WAN Expert (ACSE), SolarWinds Certified Professional (SCP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), or equivalent.

*** Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification. ***

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

The Opportunity:

Client Provisioning Manager

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

Position Summary

The Client Provisioning Manager - Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) leads client access provisioning operations supporting the revenue cycle workforce and healthcare client environments. This role is accountable for delivering secure, timely, accurate, and scalable access throughout the user lifecycle while ensuring client readiness, operational control, and a strong service experience.

The Manager leads the Client Provisioning team and partners closely with IAM, RCM Operations, Information Technology, Security, Implementation teams, application owners, and client stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines people's leadership, operational excellence, healthcare/RCM knowledge, strong client partnership, and an automation-first mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Client Provisioning Operations

  • Lead day-to-day client provisioning and access administration operations across multiple healthcare clients.
  • Oversee onboarding, access changes, transfers, client assignments, terminations, and deprovisioning activities.
  • Manage service performance, including SLAs, request volumes, backlog, aging, quality, escalations, and workload.
  • Ensure provisioning activities follow established security, authorization, documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the management escalation point for complex provisioning and client access issues.
  • Balance operational priorities and team capacity while maintaining a strong client and employee experience.

Client Implementation & Access Readiness

  • Represent Client Provisioning throughout new RCM client implementations, transitions, and go-live activities.
  • Partner with implementation and operational teams to identify provisioning requirements early in the client lifecycle.
  • Ensure access models, application requirements, approval processes, client documentation, escalation paths, and knowledge transfer are established before transition to steady-state operations.
  • Identify provisioning dependencies, readiness gaps, and operational risks and engage the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
  • Support structured handoffs from implementation teams into ongoing operational support.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish consistent and repeatable provisioning processes across clients while maintaining documented client-specific requirements where necessary.
  • Maintain operational procedures, SOPs, access matrices, client documentation, and escalation processes.
  • Identify manual, repetitive, and high-volume processes that can be simplified or automated.
  • Partner with IAM Engineering and technology teams to improve identity lifecycle and access-delivery processes.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual handoffs, rework, and dependency on individual or undocumented knowledge.

Team Leadership & Capacity Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop Client Provisioning team members.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
  • Manage workload and capacity based on client demand, complexity, priority, and available resources.
  • Build cross-training, backup coverage, and knowledge-sharing practices across the team.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, exceptional service, and innovation.

Performance & Governance

  • Establish and monitor key operational metrics, including provisioning volume, SLA performance, backlog, aging, quality, capacity, and automation opportunities.
  • Use operational data to identify trends, risks, resource constraints, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide transparent reporting to IAM leadership and key business partners.
  • Support access governance, audit, security, and compliance requirements related to client provisioning
  • Ensure access-removal and termination processes receive appropriate operational priority.

Required Qualifications

  • Leadership experience within Revenue Cycle Management, Identity & Access Management, Client Provisioning, Healthcare IT Operations, Access Administration, or a related operational function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams in a high-volume, service-oriented environment.
  • Understanding of identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, access changes, transfers, terminations, provisioning, deprovisioning, approvals, and access management.
  • Experience managing operational performance, SLAs, workload, capacity, and escalations.
  • Strong client-facing, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to establish and improve operational processes, controls, documentation, and accountability.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

data.description:
En Imagemaker We are looking for an Observability leader. This role exists to translate regulatory and business requirements into an end-to-end monitoring architecture approvable by the bank, ensuring that all telemetry (logs, traces and business events) is ingested, correlated and measured accurately before going to production.

Responsabilidades

  • Design the end-to-end observability architecture (HLD/LLD) approved by Central SRE.
  • Define the catalog of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and critical transactional journeys.
  • Specify the instrumentation of traces, logs and business events with privacy rules.
  • Develop executive dashboards and automatic alerts as code using Terraform and Monaco.
  • Audit the technical quality and pull requests of the observability team.
  • Lead planning, backlog and technical risks with the client.
  • Deliver the production promotion package.

Requisitos

Imprescindibles (Must-Have)

  • Engineering in Dynatrace SaaS (3rd Generation): Master the native cloud ecosystem, including Grail (unified data store for logs and events), DQL (Dynatrace Query Language or query language), Notebooks, Dashboards and Business Events, discarding profiles that only operate classic versions on-premise.
  • End-to-End Observability Architecture: Design end-to-end solutions under the methodology of "design before build", definiendo catálogos de SLIs (Service Level Indicators or service level indicators), SLOs (Service Level Objectives or service level objectives), error budgets (error budgets) and maps of critical flows between decoupled systems.
  • Instrumentation and Distributed Telemetry: Specify and validate the capture of distributed traces, logs and metrics using Dynatrace OneAgent and OpenTelemetry standards, ensuring that microservice responses include the fields of the transactional data dictionary.
  • Monitoring as Code (MaC) y Control de Versiones: Develop, version and deploy monitoring configurations as code (alerts, dashboards and objectives) using Terraform and Monaco (Dynatrace Monitoring as Code) over Git and Bitbucket repositories through approval workflows of Pull Requests.
  • Security, Privacy and Regulatory Compliance: Implement strict rules for masking and obfuscation of sensitive data under PII (Personally Identifiable Information or personally identifiable information) and PCI (Payment Card Industry or payment card industry) regulations, ensuring auditable measurements for regulators.
  • Cloud Native Environments and Operating Systems: Understand the architecture and telemetry ingestion over container clusters in Kubernetes and OpenShift (including Atlas or Anthos distributions), as well as Unix/Linux base environments and API consumption (Application Programming Interfaces or programming interfaces).

Deseables (Nice-to-Have)

  • Advanced AI and Automation Capabilities in Dynatrace: Configure causal artificial intelligence engines (Davis AI) for automatic anomaly detection, and design automated flows (Workflows) and synthetic monitoring tests (Synthetics) to simulate end-to-end transactions.
  • Official Dynatrace Certifications: Hold the accreditation Dynatrace Associate (required in the formal tender but relaxed by the client in favor of verifiable experience) or the higher level Dynatrace Professional.
  • Experience in Banking or Real-Time Payment Methods: Having instrumented highly critical, low-latency financial ecosystems, understanding the lifecycle of interbank transfers, clearing houses and regulatory reporting to central banks.
  • Advanced Technical English: Have fluent technical reading ability to interpret official documentation of SaaS platforms and release notes (release notes), complementing the native or fluent Spanish required for daily operations.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) | Feeld

conditions.details: Act as a first responder for critical P0/P1 production incidents, including out-of-hours incidents. Comfortable participating in out-of-hours incident response as part of the team's coverage model.

data.description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of Feeld, GT is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join a fast-growing consumer mobile product in the online dating space.

About the Client

Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.

About the Project

You'll join a consumer mobile product with an engineering and product organization of around 50 people distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

The engineering organization works in small, autonomous product squads supported by a Platform Team responsible for the underlying infrastructure, reliability, and shared engineering capabilities.

Because the team operates across multiple regions without a full follow-the-sun model, strong observability, monitoring, and reliable incident response are essential.

From a technical perspective, the team is focused on building reliable, observable systems that allow engineers to identify issues early, understand their impact, and respond quickly when incidents occur.

  • Technology stack: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, AWS, Cloudflare, CloudWatch, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and Amplitude. React Native is used on the mobile side.

  • Team: You'll join the Platform Team, working closely with cross-functional product squads distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer with a strong backend engineering background in Node.js and TypeScript to join the Platform Team.

The ideal profile is someone who started in backend/software engineering and has moved into SRE or reliability-focused work, combining a strong understanding of application code with hands-on experience in observability, infrastructure, system architecture, and production incident management.

You will help design, build, and improve the platform's reliability and observability capabilities, supporting critical services and user journeys across the product.

Beyond maintaining existing infrastructure and monitoring solutions, the role requires the ability to architect and implement new reliability solutions, making technical decisions and building capabilities from the ground up where needed.

An important part of the role is being able to interpret production signals, identify when something is going wrong, and begin mitigating incidents independently while bringing in the wider engineering team when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and improve reliability and observability solutions across the platform.

  • Contribute to the architecture of infrastructure, monitoring, and reliability capabilities, including designing and implementing new solutions from scratch.

  • Define, build, and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerts for critical services and user journeys.

  • Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs for key services and product-level metrics.

  • Improve monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting across the platform.

  • Leverage observability and product analytics tools to identify reliability issues and understand their impact on users.

  • Act as a first responder for critical P0/P1 production incidents, including out-of-hours incidents.

  • Investigate production signals, identify potential root causes, and begin mitigating issues independently.

  • Coordinate with other engineers when broader support or escalation is required.

  • Participate in incident triage, mitigation, and postmortems.

  • Identify recurring reliability issues and drive improvements to infrastructure, tooling, system architecture, and incident-response processes.

  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, product squads, and other members of the Platform Team.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience

  • Strong previous experience as a Backend / Software Engineer, with senior-level hands-on experience in Node.js and TypeScript, ideally including NestJS.

  • Hands-on experience working in an SRE, Production Engineering, or similar reliability-focused role.

  • Strong production experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Cloudflare and CloudWatch.

  • Practical experience with Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and Amplitude.

  • Strong understanding of observability across metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting.

  • Experience designing or architecting infrastructure, reliability, or observability solutions, including building new capabilities from scratch.

  • Practical experience responding to production incidents, including triage, mitigation, and postmortems.

  • Ability to interpret monitoring signals and independently investigate and begin resolving production issues.

  • Understanding of both the application and infrastructure layers rather than infrastructure-only experience.

  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills, with the ability to design scalable and maintainable solutions.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a distributed engineering team.

  • Comfortable participating in out-of-hours incident response as part of the team's coverage model.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience defining SLIs and SLOs for product-level metrics.

  • Experience with React Native or exposure to mobile application environments.

  • Previous experience with consumer mobile products or high-traffic B2C systems.

Interview Steps

  1. GT interview with Recruiter

  2. Technical interview

  3. Final interview

  4. Reference Check

We go beyond usual perks… By working with us, you will get:

  • Health insurance.

  • Wellbeing budget.

  • Sport coverage.

  • Learning budget.

  • 18 business days of paid vacation days per year

  • Paid sick leaves.

  • All public holidays are paid days off.

We are looking for an experienced Power Platform Solution Architect to join an international Agile delivery team. The successful candidate will act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Microsoft Power Platform landscape, designing secure, scalable, and supportable solutions across Power Platform, Azure, and connected enterprise systems.

The role combines architectural leadership with practical technical involvement, guiding delivery teams from concept and solution design through implementation, deployment, production stabilization, and continuous improvement.

Tasks

  • Act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Power Platform landscape.
  • Translate business capabilities, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into pragmatic end-to-end solution architectures.
  • Design end-to-end architectures covering Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Azure services, and external integrations.
  • Define solution boundaries, data models, integration patterns, security concepts, environment strategies, and deployment approaches.

data.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Essential Functions

Federal System Administration

Commercial Support & Growth

Security & Compliance

Competencies

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products. Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Senior DevOps Engineer Role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Nearform, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure to support scalable and reliable applications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and managing cloud-based infrastructure on AWS.
  • Creating and maintaining deployment architectures and continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Designing high-availability and fault-tolerant solutions for applications.
  • Implementing monitoring frameworks, including dashboards, alerts, and escalation processes.
  • Automating infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Managing containerized applications and orchestrating deployments using Kubernetes.
  • Ensuring security best practices are applied across CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and microservices.
  • Optimizing system performance and scalability through observability and proactive monitoring.
  • Collaborating with development teams to streamline deployment workflows and improve DevOps processes.
  • Advising clients on best practices for cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and system security.
  • Engaging in technical discussions with stakeholders and supporting project execution to ensure timely delivery.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.

What we are looking for in this person

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.
  • Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.
  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.
  • Strong experience managing and automating cloud-based infrastructure on AWS.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, ideally Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Scripting and automation expertise, preferably with Python.
  • Experience with observability tools and monitoring frameworks for system performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of security best practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
    An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
    A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your DevOps engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
    A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.

Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

Our salary range starts from £75,000 + bonus & benefits and will be discussed during the initial interview based on your experience.

data.title: Staff Developer, Authentication Enablement
data.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We're looking for a Staff Developer to join our Authentication Enablement team. Our mission is to help people, families and businesses unlock 1Password and access their information safely and simply, with authentication that stays in the background. Every 1Password app establishes its session with our servers through the service this team owns, whether the user signs in with a password and Secret Key, SSO, a passkey, MFA or a trusted device.

As a Staff Developer, you’ll help move authentication out of the monolith and into an independent service with its own data, so sign-in can scale and stay available independently of the rest of the platform. The service continues to handle production traffic throughout the migration, so we’re moving endpoint by endpoint and table by table, with weighted rollouts, consistency checks and tested rollback procedures. You'll help set the technical direction for the migration and for new authentication services, as 1Password extends trusted access to AI agents.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Significant experience building and operating backend services.

  • Deep expertise with distributed systems and data: moving live traffic or data between systems without downtime, event streaming or change data capture, and keeping two sources of truth consistent through a cutover.

  • Strong experience designing asynchronous workflows and migrating synchronous processes that depend on large atomic transactions to eventually consistent designs, while preserving correctness, clarifying tradeoffs, and improving performance.

  • Working knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth, OIDC, WebAuthn, passkeys, or MFA, including common implementation pitfalls and security risks.

  • A track record of setting technical direction for a team: owning large, multi-quarter projects, writing the designs others build from, and explaining tradeoffs to engineers and leadership alike.

  • You raise the engineers around you through reviews, design feedback and mentoring, and you work to hand off ownership rather than holding on.

Bonus points for:

  • Extensive experience with Go or another backend language such as Java, C#, Rust, C++, or Python.

  • Experience extracting services from a monolith.

  • Experience with MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and DynamoDB at scale.

  • Familiarity with Secure Remote Password protocol.

  • Owning services with strict availability targets, including SLOs, on-call and incident response.

What you can expect:

  • Lead a portion of the authentication service's roadmap for the next 12 months, and work closely with leadership to ensure that planning reflects the full scope of requirements.

  • Own significant designs in the remaining migration: moving session and device management flows, switching source of truth one provable iteration at a time, and publishing authentication events for other services to consume.

  • Make and document the team's technical decisions, weighing reliability and security against delivery.

  • Set the team's standards for testing, observability and safe rollout, so regressions surface before customers see them.

  • Build the platform pieces the service needs when 1Password doesn't have them yet, and work with sibling teams to propagate new distributed system standards across the organization.

  • Partner with the Authorization, Identity Services and Security teams, and guide the product teams whose features depend on authentication as they integrate with the service.

  • Hold AI-assisted work on security-critical code to the same bar as everything else: human judgment, careful validation and small, reviewable changes.

  • Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation for tier-one services.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $192,000 USD and $278,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $167,000 CAD and $242,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.

data.title: Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation
data.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation to join our team. This remote Brazil –based role reports to the GVP of Global Service Delivery Operations.

Position Summary

The Sr. Director, AI-Powered Service Delivery & Automation is responsible for defining and executing Rimini Street's AI-powered managed services strategy and leading the transformation of AMS from a labor-based support model to an intelligence-driven, automation-enabled service delivery organization. Leveraging AI, agentic workflows, AIOps, observability, and autonomous operations, this leader will design and scale capabilities that improve engineer productivity, automate service delivery activities, accelerate issue resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and enhance client outcomes across ERP and cloud platforms.

This role is accountable for establishing and achieving measurable automation, AI adoption, productivity, service quality, and service economics targets across the AMS portfolio while driving the adoption of next-generation delivery capabilities globally.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of deploying AI and automation at scale within managed services environments and delivering measurable business outcomes through operational innovation. Success will be measured by increases in automated and AI-assisted resolution rates, reductions in manual engineering effort and cost-to-serve, improvements in service margins, and the establishment of scalable autonomous support capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Lead AI-Powered Service Delivery Transformation

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-driven managed services across ERP and cloud platforms.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate diagnosis, triage, resolution, knowledge creation, documentation, and client communications.
  • Establish business cases, governance, and measurable objectives for automated resolution, ticket deflection, engineer productivity, service quality, and margin improvement.
  • Partner across Delivery, Engineering, AI, Product, and Operations teams to drive innovation and adoption.

Build AI-Enabled and Autonomous Service Operations

  • Design and deploy AI-powered assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, and enterprise knowledge capabilities that improve support effectiveness and consistency.
  • Leverage AI, large language models, automation platforms, and knowledge assets to automate support activities and enable autonomous service operations.
  • Establish standards for AI governance, operational controls, performance measurement, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Drive the transition from reactive support to predictive, proactive, and autonomous service delivery.
  • Design and deploy capabilities that increase automated and autonomous case resolution while reducing manual engineering effort.

Drive AIOps and Intelligent Operations

  • Implement AIOps, observability, monitoring, and analytics capabilities to predict, prevent, and remediate service disruptions.
  • Advance self-healing operations through automated remediation, anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive service management.
  • Partner with ServiceNow and infrastructure teams to mature ITOM, CMDB, service mapping, discovery, and operational intelligence capabilities.

Lead AMS Delivery Transformation

  • Build and lead a global AMS Automation & AI Center of Excellence responsible for AI engineering, intelligent automation, service innovation, and next-generation delivery capabilities.
  • Transform AMS delivery from manual, case-driven execution to AI-assisted and automation-enabled workflows.
  • Standardize scalable delivery patterns, automation frameworks, and operational practices across ERP and cloud service offerings.
  • Drive adoption across global delivery teams and leadership to ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Delivery leadership to develop AI-enabled service offerings that enhance client value and differentiate Rimini Street in the marketplace.

Improve Productivity and Service Efficiency

  • Deliver capabilities that reduce administrative overhead and improve resolution speed, throughput, first-contact resolution, and engineer productivity.
  • Implement AI-assisted troubleshooting, intelligent routing, knowledge recommendations, automated documentation, and reusable resolution patterns.
  • Establish measurable improvements in cost-to-serve, service quality, and operational performance.

Deliver Scalable Platform Automation

  • Design and implement reusable automation solutions across ERP and cloud platforms, including diagnostics, monitoring, integration management, configuration validation, and release impact assessment.
  • Modernize service management processes by embedding automation, improving workflow efficiency, and enhancing operational visibility and reporting.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned to client, delivery, and business outcomes.

Desired Experience

  • 12+ years leading enterprise managed services, service operations, or technology transformation organizations.
  • Proven track record implementing AI-driven automation, autonomous operations, or digital labor solutions that materially improve service delivery performance and economics.
  • Experience deploying AI platforms, agentic workflows, enterprise knowledge systems, copilots, and intelligent automation capabilities at scale.
  • Strong technical leadership with credibility across architecture, engineering, AI, operations, and executive stakeholder communities.
  • Experience with AIOps, observability, ITOM, predictive operations, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management platforms.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise application support models across ERP and cloud platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft technologies.
  • Demonstrated success building new capabilities and leading global transformation programs that improve automation rates, productivity, service quality, customer outcomes, and margin performance.
  • Experience delivering measurable reductions in support effort, ticket volume, or cost-to-serve through AI, automation, or autonomous operations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, platform, or automation teams within a global managed services organization.

Desired Skills

  • Deep expertise in AI-driven service delivery, agentic automation, autonomous operations, AIOps, observability, and intelligent automation platforms.
  • Strong technical foundation in APIs, integrations, orchestration, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management technologies.
  • Ability to translate technology innovation into measurable business outcomes, including productivity gains, cost reduction, service quality improvements, and margin expansion.
  • Technology-first leadership style with the ability to lead at strategic, architectural, and operational levels.
  • Proven success driving organizational transformation, stakeholder alignment, and adoption across global teams.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and influencing skills with experience building and scaling high-performing teams and Centers of Excellence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Location

Remote – Brazil

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients

  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth
