data.title: Data Scientist
data.description:
Job Title

Data Scientist

Hiring Manager

David Corney

Salary

£41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience

Location

Remote first within the UK. We work primarily from home but also have an office available in Central London for quarterly in-person meetings with the AI team and with meetings with the rest of Full Fact. You can expect to travel to the office at least 4 times per year.

Please note that we do not hold a UKVI Sponsorship Licence, so we cannot consider sponsoring a visa applicant or issuing a Certificate of Sponsorship.

Reporting to

Senior Data Scientist

Employment Type

Permanent

We are happy to talk about flexible working, including part time.

Application Closing Date

10 am on Monday 30 November 2026.

Introduction to the role

At a moment when our information environment is under significant strain, this is an exciting opportunity: a role with real autonomy, meaningful mission, and genuine influence at the intersection of AI and web scale engineering.

As a Data Scientist at Full Fact, you will make sure those who make false claims in public can't get away with it. This is a rare opportunity to work for a non-profit tackling internet-scale misinformation problems with a global user base. The fact checks our users publish are seen hundreds of millions of times each year and embedded in many of the most well-known internet services.

Every day, 100s of people around the world find, check, archive and challenge false claims identified by AI-enabled products produced by Full Fact. Your job will be to help us improve and expand this software for our growing user base. You’ll be working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and real-world impact.

Whether you're responding to a new feature request from users in Nigeria covering a general election, helping fact checkers in Australia verify politicians' claims in real time, or enabling health-focused charities to identify and reduce harmful content spreading online, you will be working at pace on projects that make a substantial difference in the world. In this role that means prototyping and developing features with robust APIs, writing clean Python, and working closely with engineers and other data scientists to bring AI-powered features into production.

It is an exciting time to join Full Fact. You will be joining a team of technical, data, and product specialists working on genuinely novel problems in applied AI, from natural language processing and claim detection to trust benchmarks and harm detection.

We will support you to keep learning, and if you are interested in applying but not sure you have all the skills, please do apply. We are open both to supporting learning on the job and to rearranging tasks within the team to suit the skillsets of the best applicant

Job Definition

As an experienced Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to a number of new and ongoing projects. You will use your technical skills to design and develop software that identifies and counters misinformation. You will develop and use a variety of datasets to train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with non-technical colleagues and other users of our tools. You will participate in code review, both of your own and of others' code.

Outcomes

Some of the projects you will be contributing to include:

  • Extending our new “Public Interest AI Trust Benchmark” to provide a deeper analysis of how reliably AI chatbots answer everyday questions.

  • Spotting potentially misleading and harmful claims across a broad range of media

  • Identifying and characterising potentially harmful narratives as they spread

  • Helping to integrate the technologies you build into products that will have an immediate use, for both fact checkers and journalists

  • Identifying sightings of previously checked claims at real-time speed

  • Measuring and improving the quality of the system

What we are looking for from you

Political impartiality and sensitivity:

You are committed to the political neutrality of our work and have a good understanding of impartiality (please see the rules on our website).

Understanding of public debate in the UK and sensitivity to the political context we work in.

Skills/competencies

  • Software engineering for data science. You are familiar with the software development lifecycle. You can design, code, test, correct and document moderate to complex programs and scripts from agreed specifications with or without AI coding tools. You can use agreed standards and tools. Collaborate with others to review and refine specifications where appropriate.

  • AI and data science innovation. You are broadly familiar with recent advances in AI including LLMs. You proactively research and explore areas of innovation in our industry. You can identify the value for innovation within the organisation.

  • Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices. You understand and can help teams apply a range of practices. You know how to develop deeper expertise on a narrower range of specialisms. You can start to apply emerging theory to practical situations.

  • Developing data science capability. You promote and monitor continuous professional development within your organisation. You know how to develop knowledge of cutting-edge techniques and share this knowledge. You can develop and support data science capability across the organisation.

  • Domain expertise. You can create automated fact-checking products that are proportionate to the operational benefit and achieve significant impact. You know how to present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages. You can develop data science communication skills within your team. You support the evolution of data governance and take responsibility for applying ethical data science.

  • Understanding analysis across the product life cycle. You understand and can help teams apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight. You are proactive and can present compelling findings that inform wider decisions. You are starting to apply innovative approaches to resolve problems.

What we offer

A salary between £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience.

Workplace Pension

Generous holidays:

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

  • In addition, we usually close the office for a period between Christmas and New Year.

Comfortable, centrally located London office with good transport links

Employee Assistance Programme

Emergency Housing Loan and support for moving home

Volunteering day

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter using the link below by 10 am on Monday 30 November.

Our recruitment platform will remove identifying details such as email addresses to allow us to sift applications anonymously.

Before applying, please read the requirements we place on staff to protect Full Fact’s independence and non-partisanship

How the application process will work

We want to see you at your best to understand your strengths and the contribution you could make at Full Fact with strong support, including for your learning and development. We also want to make sure that we use your time well during this process and don’t ask for more from you than we need to. We will make any reasonable adjustments we need to make to this process to help ensure you can perform at your best. For more information about this before applying, please .

The interview panel will be Ellie Ashman (Head of AI), David Corney (Senior Data Scientist), and James McMinn (Senior Engineer).

The process starts off with an anonymised covering letter and CV. This will be read by at least two people to produce a shortlist for the panel interview.

The first round interviews will be an audio (not video) interview, lasting no more than half an hour, at a time that’s convenient for you. We will record it so at least two people can review each interview to decide who we invite back for the second round. The recordings will be deleted at the end of the process.

The second round will include a structured interview during which you will be asked to present some of your recent work in any way you choose. The interview will be with the full panel by video and last no more than an hour. We’ll tell you everything you need to know to prepare in advance.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/data-scientist-full-fact

data.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Tokyo)
data.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is ¥7,800,000 to ¥11,900,000 in Japan, plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits:

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range

¥7,800,000—¥11,900,000 JPY

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/field-intelligence-analyst-tokyo-sayari

data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions, including our AI investigations platform Ardence, that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily.

As an AI Scientist on our new AI Research team, you will build the models and agents behind the intelligence that powers TRM's products. Part of that is training foundation models on blockchain data, one of our most differentiated data layers, and part is building autonomous AI agents that generate intelligence at a scale hand-built heuristics cannot reach. You'll work on Intel Cortex and other ambitious, cross-cutting ideas, with a broad view across intelligence rather than a single risk category. This is pioneering work that does not exist elsewhere in our industry, and it directly drives customer outcomes, from seizing illicit funds to disrupting criminal networks.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Train ML models on blockchain data, including foundation models, and take them from research to production.

  • Build AI agents (and fine-tune LLMs where it helps) so the intelligence underneath TRM's products is generated by models and agents, not only hand-built heuristics.

  • Find new ways to generate net new intelligence, using patterns across all intelligence layers (Network / On-chain / Protocol) that competitors can't replicate.

  • Ship production-quality code: ML models, agents and data pipelines, with rigorous evaluation and scalable architecture.

  • Take on ambitious, high-impact bets that raise the ceiling of what our intelligence can do, and drive measurable outcomes: billions in illicit funds traced, seized, or prevented.

What we’re looking for:

  • Quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics). Advanced degree or equivalent research experience is a plus.

  • Strong machine learning foundations, built over years of applied ML and/or research (modeling, evaluation, experimentation). You don't need to have trained a foundation model or built agents before, but you need the fundamentals to do it.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset: gets to the root cause, leverages creativity, and thrives in ambiguity with a hypothesis-driven, iterative approach.

  • 5+ years of hands-on machine learning experience, with strong Python, SQL, and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code).

  • Experience with distributed data systems (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow) and shipping production ML code.

  • Strong async communication (Loom, Slack, Notion), strong technical communication in English, and ability to own work independently in a remote environment.

  • Bonus: experience with LLMs, AI agents or fine-tuning; domain curiosity or prior work in blockchain, crypto, fraud, money laundering or financial crime.

About the Team:

  • AI Research is a new team focused on ambitious, cross-cutting ideas in attribution and intelligence.

  • Fully remote and globally distributed. Most overlap occurs 7am–12pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • All team members must have at least 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

  • You'll work in partnership with the category pods, whose expert-built heuristics provide the high-confidence labels our models learn from.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Customer Impact. Deliver last-minute, high-stakes projects for key customers — turning around attribution insights in days, not weeks.

  • MVP to Production. Build complex algorithms with tight timeframes (1-2 sprints for MVP) and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Parallel Execution. Juggle multiple priorities across categories and stakeholders while maintaining quality and speed.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/ai-scientist-latam-trm-labs

data.description:
The Director, Enterprise Strategy Analytics, leads a team responsible for transforming enterprise questions into decision-ready insights that enable strategic, client-centered business decisions. Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Analytics & Data Management, this role serves as a senior thought partner to executive, business, and functional leaders by connecting strategy, analytics, business acumen, and client insights to evaluate opportunities and solve complex enterprise challenges.

This leader is accountable for translating ambiguity into clarity, identifying opportunities for enterprise value creation, developing analytics and measurement frameworks, and ensuring leaders have the information, context, and recommendations necessary to make informed decisions.

The Director will lead a team focused on enterprise priorities and will partner closely with Enterprise Strategy, Finance, Data, and Divisional Leadership to establish shared measures, create common understanding, and enable enterprise performance.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and advise on large, complex strategy and analytics engagements, answering the enterprise’s most important strategic questions, spanning multiple business areas, functions, products, and channels, ensuring Thrivent's most important strategic decisions are informed by trusted insights, rigorous analysis, and a scalable enterprise analytics capability.
  • Partner with senior executive leaders and business stakeholders to frame difficult or undefined business questions, clarify decision needs, identify relevant hypotheses, and establish engagement scope, deliverables, and measures of success.
  • Lead team of dedicated analysts with specialized knowledge and business acumen working on the most important strategic and business questions for the Enterprise. Establish engagement priorities and direct Enterprise Analytics resources toward the organization's highest-value strategic opportunities.
  • Facilitate hypothesis-driven problem solving to support business strategy, growth opportunities, operational effectiveness, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Proactively identify emerging risks, opportunities, and strategic questions where analysis or decision support could improve growth, client or advisor outcomes, investment prioritization, operating effectiveness, or transformation results.
  • Identify new ongoing data needs and requirements and champion the establishment of new systems and data sources in partnership with Data Product Leadership and appropriate business areas.
  • Define and evolve the Enterprise Analytics methodologies, and consulting practices.
  • Recruit, develop, and sustain a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.
  • Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes. ​
  • Support and/or develop an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shape and/or support a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.

Describe below the audience this role will interact with and level of influence they will have on those roles.

The Director, Enterprise Analytics, serves as a senior enterprise advisor and strategic partner who influences decisions across the organization through analytics, business acumen, and consultative leadership. This role works closely with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) members, Enterprise Strategy Leaders, VP/SVP level audience across divisions to frame enterprise questions, , evaluate strategic opportunities, and deliver decision-ready recommendations. Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. The Team

You will work with a carefully selected, diverse, senior and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d).

Responsibilities

Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including:

  • Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data.
  • Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms.
  • Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively.
  • Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain.
  • A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies.

You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning:

  • Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions.
  • Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success.
  • Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in developing data science products, from initial research through to production deployment.
  • Previous experience in Ad-Tech industry is a must.
  • Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code.
  • Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection.
  • Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable.
  • Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset.
  • Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools.

What do we offer?

  • Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact
  • Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries.
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget
  • A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal GenAI Data Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in Santa Clara, CA or Bellevue, WA (3 days in office), reporting to the Senior Manager, Enterprise AI Data Platform in the Information Technology Data Strategy department.

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to drive the design and implementation of enterprise-grade Generative AI data ingestion, knowledge preparation, and platform architectures that enable scalable, production-ready GenAI applications. This role focuses on architecting robust pipelines and platforms for ingesting, processing, governing, and serving structured and unstructured enterprise data for AI/LLM workloads. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, unstructured data pipelines, GenAI platform engineering, and strong software engineering skills in Python.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect enterprise-scale GenAI data platforms for ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and serving of structured and unstructured data
  • Design scalable pipelines for enterprise knowledge ingestion from diverse data sources including documents, SaaS platforms, knowledge bases, collaboration tools, and databases
  • Define architecture for metadata extraction, chunking, enrichment, embeddings generation, and knowledge preparation workflows
  • Design AI-ready data models and storage strategies for vector, graph, and hybrid knowledge systems
  • Architect scalable unstructured data processing pipelines for text, images, PDFs, tables, and multimodal content

Who You Are

  • You’re comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking For

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Expert-level Python programming and software engineering capabilities
  • Experience building distributed/scalable data pipelines for AI workloads
  • Strong understanding of unstructured data extraction and processing pipelines
  • Experience with vector databases, graph databases, and metadata/knowledge storage systems
  • Hands-on experience with clustering, entity recognition algorithms, and modern retrieval strategies (including RAG, search, and agentic AI workflows)

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Advanced experience architecting real-time distributed vector search infrastructure and multi-modal knowledge graph pipelines for enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications
  • Experience with LLMOps / GenAIOps frameworks such as LangSmith, Evaluation Framework like Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases, or MLflow
  • Familiarity with Agent Frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google ADK

data.description:
Headquarters: Turkey
URL: https://sezzle.com

The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation  
  • Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data
  • Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes  
  • Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses  
  • Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and  controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes  
  • Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission  
  • Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline  
  • Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios  
  • Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others  

What We Look For: 

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic
  • Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 
  • Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

  • Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

  • Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt) 
  • WS, G Suite, Mac
  • Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging
  • Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.
  • Offer

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Manager – AI & Data Platform Engineering within the Enterprise Data & AI Platform Engineering department. This is a remote role within the United States (with a hybrid preference for San Jose, CA), reporting directly to the Senior Manager – Data Strategy, to lead the evolution of our enterprise data platform into an AI-ready data and knowledge platform. Sitting at the intersection of Data Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, and Generative AI, you will combine a deep foundation in modern data engineering and cloud platforms with practical experience building RAG systems, knowledge graphs, AI/LLM data pipelines, and production-grade AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning architecture, engineering execution, people leadership, and platform strategy.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead a team of data and AI engineers across the US and India, owning performance, career development and day-to-day execution across both full-time staff and contractors
  • Own the Data Platform (Snowflake, dbt, Matillion) and the in-house pipelines that build the enterprise's knowledge and AI foundations, turning structured and unstructured data into trusted, AI-ready assets such as knowledge graphs and vector stores, accountable for quality, reliability and delivery
  • Turn platform strategy and architecture direction into roadmaps, quarterly plans and delivered outcomes, partnering with architects and engineering leadership and shifting focus across data, knowledge and AI work as priorities change
  • Run the platform as a product for internal customers such as domain delivery teams, BI, context and semantic teams and AI engineering, defining service levels, onboarding paths and paved roads that make self-service and AI-native development fast and safe
  • Build agentic operations that automate the team's operational work, such as pipeline monitoring, failure triage, data quality checks and remediation, and establish a reusable framework and standards that other teams can adopt for their own operations

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You possess a comprehensive understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle from enterprise data ingestion and transformation to knowledge retrieval, context engineering, and production agent deployment.
  • You are equally adept at driving architectural strategy and engaging in technical implementation details, making pragmatic decisions to eliminate technical debt.
  • You are an inspiring people leader committed to hiring, mentoring, and advancing engineering team members while cultivating a culture of ownership and engineering excellence.
  • Versatile across data platforms, knowledge engineering and agentic operations, you’re equally at home in any of the three. You lead a globally distributed team with an owner’s mindset and a bias for action, and you thrive in a fast-moving AI landscape.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

Senior Computer Vision / ML Engineer

Full-time | Remote | Australia

About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions helps organizations assess and manage risk across identity verification, fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, credit risk, and customer data management.

About Our Team

IDVerse builds identity verification technology to fight fraud at global scale. Our systems must stay effective against evolving attacks including spoofing, deepfakes, injection attacks, and AI-generated fraud. We are a team of researchers and engineers who think from first principles, experiment rigorously, and invent new approaches as we continuously improve our systems.

What You'll Do

  • Research and invent: Investigate difficult problems in computer vision, biometrics, liveness, anti-spoofing, deepfake detection, generative AI, and adversarial attacks. Form hypotheses, run controlled experiments, and develop conclusions that can be trusted. Understand not only whether something works, but why it works, where it fails, and what to try next.
  • Red Team Mindset: Develop novel presentation, injection, deepfake, synthetic-media, and AI generated attacks against our systems. Build adversarial evaluations, expose weaknesses, understand their underlying causes, and develop robust defenses.
  • Build advanced CV/ML models: Design, train, evaluate, and optimize deep learning approaches across image, video, and multimodal data, applying techniques such as representation learning, transformers, generative models, 3D/geometric vision, where appropriate.
  • Own research through production: Take ideas from research and prototyping through benchmarking, optimization, deployment, and real-world evaluation.
  • Push the state of the art: Stay close to emerging computer vision and AI research, reproduce and challenge promising ideas, and identify opportunities to turn research advances into meaningful improvements to IDVerse products.

Required qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning, backed by strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, optimization, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve open-ended research and engineering problems, rather than only implementing established solutions.
  • Strong experience with Python and PyTorch or equivalent modern deep-learning
  • frameworks.
  • Experience designing controlled experiments, analyzing model behavior and failure modes, and evaluating models against challenging datasets.
  • Ability to translate research concepts into efficient, reliable production systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. Experience with C/C++, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics,
  • Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

Highly Desirable

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in computer vision, machine learning, AI, mathematics, or a related field.
  • Publications, patents, significant open-source contributions, competition results, or other evidence of original technical or research contributions.
  • Experience with biometrics, liveness / presentation attack detection, deepfakes, synthetic media, adversarial ML, or AI security.

The team is remote and globally distributed. Candidates must have full working rights in Australia.

Position Summary...

Lead the analytics practice that changes how Walmart’s audit teams work. As Director, Data Analytics, you’ll turn data, automation and emerging technology into products that sharpen audit coverage, surface risk sooner and deliver results the business can measure. You’ll partner with audit teams across the organization to spark new ways of working, share what you learn and scale what works, all while leading a team in a space that never stands still. It’s an opportunity to pair deep analytical expertise with a product mindset and inspirational leadership at Walmart’s scale.



About the Team:

We’re an innovation-minded analytics team working alongside audit teams, business partners and technology functions. We treat analytics as products: we find the right problems, ship solutions people actually use, and measure the difference they make. We share what we build and what we learn, from reusable methods to new tools, so every audit team can move faster and see further. Our work supports trusted, accessible and responsible use of data, and we adapt quickly as risks, technology and priorities change.

What you'll do...

  • Drive innovation in how audit works: Spot opportunities to apply analytics, automation and emerging technology to audit planning, risk assessment, testing and reporting. Question long-standing assumptions, prototype quickly and turn the best ideas into solutions with clear success criteria, metrics and measurable return on investment.
  • Engage audit teams and drive change: Partner with audit teams across the organization to understand how they work, co-design solutions that fit and lead the adoption that makes change stick. Influence stakeholders at every level and turn early wins into new ways of working.
  • Share knowledge and raise the bar: Introduce new tools, methods and ideas to audit teams, and share what you learn through playbooks, demos, communities of practice and mentoring. Make good analytical practice easy for others to adopt, adapt and build on.
  • Run analytics like a product: Own a roadmap that connects audit priorities to analytics and technology delivery. Define the customer, the problem and the outcome; prioritize ruthlessly; assess costs and resource needs; deliver in increments; and report on adoption, quality, time saved and risk insight gained.
  • Drive technology governance and enterprise compliance: Ensure analytics products, AI solutions, and automation initiatives align with Walmart’s enterprise technology, security, and governance requirements. Lead and coordinate internal review and approval processes, including Solution Security Plan (SSP), Enterprise Privacy Risk Assessment (EPRA) and other applicable reviews for deployed solutions. Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology teams to identify risks, address requirements, and obtain necessary approvals before deployment, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant, and scalable.
  • Find the signal and tell the story: Identify fit-for-purpose data across existing systems and distributed data stores, perform data quality checks, and use exploratory analysis, statistical methods and models to test hypotheses and surface insight. Select the right visualization tools and build clear, compelling stories for analysts, audit leaders and executives, partnering with user experience designers and engineers when front-end applications are needed.
  • Advance data strategy, quality and responsible use: Apply and influence data strategy across audit and business domains. Define data quality rules, metrics and service-level strategies, recommend improvements to data governance policies and practices, manage user access as needed, and support requirements for data privacy, security, storage, retention and documentation.
  • Lead with energy and develop people: Recruit, develop and mentor talent, identify capability gaps and support succession planning and continuous learning. Build a curious, motivated team that is comfortable with change, and foster an environment grounded in Walmart’s standards of integrity and ethics, including the Open Door Policy.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven experience leading innovation and turning ideas into delivered solutions, with a strong product mindset and a record of defining success measures and reporting measurable impact and business value.
  • A strong analytical background, with experience in exploratory data analysis and statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, correlation and statistical modeling, using tools or languages such as SQL, Python, SAS, Oracle, Apache Mahout or Excel.
  • Experience identifying and working with data across business systems and distributed data stores, including SQL and NoSQL technologies, with an understanding of data modeling, integration, storage and warehousing.
  • Experience creating visualizations and communicating insights using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Python or R, including libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly or ggplot, and telling a compelling story to audiences from analysts to executives.
  • An inspirational, energizing leader with experience leading initiatives and developing others, including engaging peers and stakeholders across teams, driving change and sharing knowledge through mentoring, coaching and teaching.
  • Comfort in a dynamic, changing space: the ability to adapt as priorities, technology and risks shift, challenge assumptions constructively and keep teams focused on delivery.
  • Knowledge of data management and governance, including data quality frameworks, profiling and cleansing tools, access practices, and privacy, security and retention requirements, plus knowledge of business practices and metrics across functions such as product, finance, technology, business systems or audit.

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

Our team builds machine learning models for some of the largest health plans in the country to identify and audit claims errors from simple errors to outright fraud. Large insurance payers receive tens of millions of claims each year, of which they only are able to audit less than 10%. Our claim selection models help with selecting the right set of claims to audit and recover hundreds of millions of dollars each year reducing wasted medical spend. We have made significant progress already, with models that significantly outperform even selection by human experts but there are still many improvements to be made. 

We are looking for a Sr. Data Scientist | Modeling to advance our models further. In addition to building best-in-class models, this person will create technical frameworks and tools to help the team achieve greater scale and improved business outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • Master Claim Audits: Dive into various clinical and coding audits, unpacking the data that drives audit decisions, and understanding past outcomes.

  • Model Advancement: Curate labeled data, hypothesize new features, and develop ML models that target claims for audit with even greater precision.

  • Optimize Impact: Measure model performance rigorously, translating outcomes into operational insights and recommendations for our clients.

  • Tame Complexity: Work with vast, nuanced data pipelines derived from intricate business workflows—often unclean and undefined—to refine them for robust modeling.

  • Drive Team Success: Enhance data pipelines, modeling infrastructure, and team tools to level up our capabilities and decision-making efficiency.

  • Grow with Healthcare: Build expertise in healthcare data and make an impact on the industry. Engage with clients and internal experts to refine model insights, ensuring alignment with real business needs.

What You Bring:

  • You enjoy solving real-world business problems involving data-driven optimization and ML modeling - and have been doing that successfully for a while.

  • You are comfortable measuring and optimizing the direct business impact of work. 

  • You are experienced with SQL, handling large-scale data, and are comfortable with at least one programming language (Python, R, etc.).

data.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

What You'll Do

  • Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.

  • Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.

  • Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.

  • Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains why models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.

  • Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.

  • Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.

  • Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.

  • Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.

You Must Have

  • Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.

  • Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.

  • A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.

  • Experience leading researchers and research engineers through other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.

  • AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.

  • The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.

It'd Be Great If You Had

  • TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.

  • Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.

  • Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.

  • Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.

  • Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Partnerships team helps drive customer acquisition and originations through partner offers. The team is focused on improving how offers are optimized across the customer journey.

As the Applied Scientist on the Partnerships team, you’ll use causal inference, experimentation, and machine learning to help determine which offers are most likely to support customer conversion. You’ll take on a greenfield optimization opportunity, moving from research and measurement to production-ready models and decision strategies.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Develop causal machine-learning models to optimize customer offers at different points in the funnel, from marketing-time decisions with limited information to decisions informed by customer activity on our site.
  • Analyze and interpret complex data, identify gaps in what we know, and design experiments to gather evidence for building and evaluating optimization models.
  • Measure the impact of offer changes with statistically rigorous experiments and evaluations.
  • Translate research and results into clear recommendations, decision strategies, and next steps for business and technical partners.
  • Build production-ready models and code for use in offer selection.
  • Partner with Partnerships leadership, Product, Engineering, peer machine-learning teams, and model-risk partners to align on strategy, implementation, and methodology.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.
  • Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied-science or data-science context.
  • Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
  • Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a quantitative field.
  • Experience with marketplace optimization, particularly where pricing or offer decisions are central.
  • Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
  • Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
  • Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production-model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
  • Ability to translate broad business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

data.description:
About Cantina

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role

We’re working on real-time video generation for interactive characters, spanning realistic humans, stylized characters, and non-human identities. We want these characters to feel present: to speak, react, and express themselves through their face, gestures, and body language.

This brings together a set of closely connected research problems. A character needs a consistent appearance, expressive and coherent motion, and a natural relationship between speech and movement. The model also needs to respond quickly and keep generating reliably as an interaction unfolds. Quality, controllability, and efficiency all matter.

You’ll work across streaming generation, fine-tuning, distillation, inference optimization, and data. Some problems will call for a new training approach; others will come down to better examples, a more useful evaluation, or understanding a bottleneck in the implementation. Part of the job is figuring out which intervention is worth making.

You’ll have substantial freedom to propose directions, investigate unfamiliar ideas, and shape what we work on next. We’re looking for someone who enjoys that freedom and can turn it into a steady sequence of useful experiments.

What You’ll Work On

  • Real-time and streaming generation. Develop models that support responsive interaction while maintaining visual quality and consistency over time. Investigate latency, continuity, and how model behavior changes during longer generation.

  • Character expression and motion. Explore how appearance, facial expression, gesture, and body movement come together into a coherent character. Improve the relationship between speech and motion across different identities and visual styles.

  • Fine-tuning and post-training. Adapt video models to new data, behaviors, and capabilities. Investigate training objectives and conditioning methods, and follow promising ideas through implementation and evaluation.

  • Distillation and inference optimization. Make generation faster and more efficient. Work across model-level approaches and runtime improvements, measuring their effects on quality, latency, and memory.

  • Data development. Spend meaningful time with the actual training examples. Identify missing coverage and recurring failure modes, improve curation and sampling, and develop data that helps models learn the behavior we want.

  • Evaluation. Build comparisons that make progress visible and failures understandable. Combine quantitative measurements with careful inspection of generated video and the experience of interacting with the model.

  • Research and collaboration. Read relevant work, reproduce and adapt useful ideas, and share early experiments, demos, and findings. Help the team decide what deserves more time and compute.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience training or fine-tuning video or related generative models.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar methods quickly and turn ideas into useful experiments.

  • Good experimental judgment, ownership, and clear communication.

You’ll have freedom to explore new approaches. We expect fast iteration and early sharing of results.

Compensation

When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits for U.S.-based roles:

  • Competitive salary and generous company equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

    • 10 sick days

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like
