About the Role:

We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for VC and adjacent tasks (controllable TTS, voice design and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • See research and engineering as two sides of the same coin and enjoy owning work end-to-end.

  • Are results-oriented, flexible, and willing to pick up whatever moves the needle.

  • Like collaborating closely with infra, data, and product to ship measurable improvements.

  • Enjoy designing experiments, listening tests, and metrics that correlate with user-perceived quality.

  • Eager to learn every-day, find and solve unique large-scale problems.

What You’ll Do:

  • Model Building: Architect, implement, pre-train, fine-tune, and post-train/alignment (e.g., GRPO/DPO) for large-scale speech models.

  • Experimental Design: Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of the models.

  • Tool Development: Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity.

The Opportunity

Data Engineers at Hinge Health are software engineers who specialize in building data pipelines, designing and implementing both OLTP and data warehouse schemas, data governance, ETL, RDBMS, and NoSQL systems. They create self-service tools and automation so application engineers and data scientists can manage their data independently and securely, following best practices for HIPAA compliance. The ideal candidate is self-driven and enjoys working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

You will be working with a team of experienced data engineers who build and maintain a data platform that hosts petabytes of data. This platform supports key business decisions and powers important product features for our members.

Our stack: Python, SQL, dbt, Metaplane, Airflow, PostgreSQL, REST, Docker, Tonic.ai, Terraform, Spark, Kafka, Flink,Fivetran, Databricks, AWS (S3, RDS). Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security/compliance posture is at the highest standards of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines that deliver correct, on-time data to analytics and product teams.

  • Implement dimensional data models and dbt transformations from a design that you and a senior engineer agree on.

  • Add data quality tests, monitors, and alerts to the pipelines that you own. Respond when they fire.

  • Apply the team's HIPAA and PII patterns when you handle member data. This includes access control, tagging, and audit trails.

  • Diagnose and tune slow or expensive pipelines and queries. Report the cause and the measured improvement.

  • Support business stakeholders and data scientists who use first-party and third-party data. Answer questions about the models that you build.

  • Turn a business requirement into a technical design for one pipeline or one data model. Write it down before you build.

  • Take part in on-call rotation for the data platform. Write and improve runbooks for the failures that you fix.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree

  • 3+ years of data engineering experience

  • 2+ years of experience in processing and storing large scale data using distributed systems as well as working knowledge of database designs and data warehousing including star and snowflake schemas.

  • 2+ years of experience working with broad spectrum of OLTP data stores like PostgreSQL,MySQL, MongoDB, Redis and OLAP stores like Databricks,Snowflake, Redshift

  • 1+ years of experience building data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Airflow

  • 1+ years of experience designing and implementing data warehouse models (e.g., STAR, Snowflake), as well as developing ELT and ETL pipelines within data lake ecosystems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mastery of SQL and Python

  • Working knowledge of IAC like terraform

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially in communicating complex technical problems with non-technical stakeholders

  • 1+ year experience working with dbt

  • Knowledge of streaming systems like Flink, Kafka streams or spark streaming

  • Experience with managed data integration platforms like Fivetran,Estuary

  • Experience building data products that serve machine learning: feature pipelines, training datasets, or model-serving inputs.

  • Daily use of AI coding assistants, and interest in AI-powered self-serve analytics such as natural-language query over a data warehouse.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • We also offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture and Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

data.title: Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will turn model capabilities into real product behavior. You will own problems end-to-end, from shaping model behavior, to building the systems around it, to ensuring it performs reliably in production.

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and product, focusing on making AI actually work for users, not just in demos, but in real-world usage.

Focus

  • Build and ship AI features end-to-end (model → system → user experience)

  • Design and iterate on prompts, tools, memory, and agent workflows

  • Turn raw model outputs into structured, reliable, and predictable behaviors

  • Debug issues across the full stack (model, orchestration, infra, UX)

  • Optimize for latency, cost, and production reliability

  • Develop lightweight evaluation frameworks to measure real-world performance

  • Work closely with product and engineering to translate ambiguous problems into working systems

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • LLMs (OpenAI-style APIs, LLaMA, Qwen, etc.)

  • Inference / serving (e.g. vLLM)

  • Vector DB

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundation in machine learning and modern neural network architectures.

  • Hands-on experience with training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models

  • Ability to write clean, production-quality code

  • Comfort working across abstraction layers (model → infra → product)

  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, latency, and reliability targets.

  • Production issues are identified quickly, debugged effectively, and root causes addressed.

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are robust, reproducible, and maintainable.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineers, product, and research teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

  • Iterations on models and systems are driven by real-world signals and measurable improvements.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical AI product.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Enterprise Data Warehouse & Analytics
data.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

Machinify brings together several payment integrity and recovery businesses for health plans. Each one produces numbers that executives, operations leaders, and clients act on. Your job is to make sure there is one warehouse, one conformed model, and one definition of every number. 

The foundation is already in production: a Databricks lakehouse with 600+ dbt models, 1,800+ automated tests, Power BI semantic models, and LLM self-service on governed metrics. Your first priority is operational measurement: building the trusted metrics our Operations leaders run their business on. Next, you'll extend the warehouse to new business domains with a repeatable, template-driven approach. 

This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role on a flat team. You'll manage engineers and analysts directly and spend about half your time building: designing the dimensional model, writing and reviewing code, and setting the engineering standards. You'll partner closely with a Product counterpart who owns priorities and stakeholder intake, so you can focus on architecture, delivery, and the team. 

 
What You’ll Do

  • Own the data model. Design and evolve the conformed dimensional model and the standards the team builds against. Review every new model for grain and conformance. 
  • Build and run the pipelines. Design ETL/ELT from source systems through bronze → silver → gold on Databricks, with incremental loads, data contracts, and Airflow orchestration. 
  • Own the semantic layer. Build governed metrics in Unity Catalog metric views and Power BI semantic models, so every dashboard, report, and LLM query uses the same definitions. 
  • Deliver reliable operational metrics. Turn KPI definitions from Product and Operations into certified models and metrics, reconciled to source and delivered through dashboards and self-service. 
  • Assure the numbers. Own reconciliation, data tests, freshness and anomaly monitoring, SLOs, and CI/CD for data. 
  • Modernize orchestration. Lead the move of dbt orchestration from dbt Cloud to Airflow without gaps in data freshness. 
  • Partner with Product. Work with your Product counterpart and business stakeholders to shape requirements. You own the technical plan: architecture, sequencing, estimates, and trade-offs. 
  • Lead the team. Manage, coach, and hire analytics engineers and BI analysts. Run sprint execution and set the bar for code review, testing, documentation, and AI-assisted development. 

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in data warehousing, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including 3+ years as a hands-on engineering manager. 
  • Expert in dimensional modeling: grain, fact types, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, bridge tables, and the bus matrix. Has built an enterprise warehouse across multiple source systems and owned it in production 
  • Expert SQL and dbt: complex SQL and performance tuning; dbt models, tests, macros, packages, and CI 
  • Databricks in production: Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture. Deep Snowflake or BigQuery experience will be considered 
  • Semantic layer: has built governed metrics (Databricks metric views, dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, Cube, or Power BI semantic models) and the BI on top. Power BI/DAX preferred 
  • ETL/ELT and orchestration: has designed and run production pipelines with incremental loads, snapshots or CDC, and Airflow (or a similar orchestrator). Python for pipeline work 
  • Data quality: testing, reconciliation, observability, and CI/CD for data 
  • Cross-functional partner: works well with a Product counterpart and business stakeholders. Turns requirements into technical designs and explains trade-offs in plain language 

Nice to have 

  • Healthcare claims or payment integrity data 
  • Building operational KPIs with business operators 
  • LLM-based self-service analytics (e.g., Databricks Genie) 
  • Experience leading teams across time zones

data.description:
Department:

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is Walker & Dunlop’s technology organization, bringing together product, design, engineering, data, infrastructure, information security, and operations to build, operate, and protect the technology that powers our business.

You will have the opportunity to apply modern technology and AI within one of the nation’s leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firms. W&D’s market position, deep industry expertise, client relationships, and proprietary data provide a strong foundation for solving meaningful business problems, improving how we work and serve our clients, and creating new sources of competitive advantage.

Across WDTech, we combine business context with disciplined technology practices and a high standard for security, resilience, and quality. Teams have ownership of meaningful problems and collaborate across disciplines, make thoughtful decisions, and continuously improve the products, platforms, and capabilities that move W&D forward.

The Impact You Will Have

As the VP, Analytics, Data Science & AI Data Enablement at Walker & Dunlop (W&D), you will lead the company's Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Data Science functions while advancing how AI is used to analyze data and inform business decisions.

In this role, you will set the strategy for how W&D turns data into actionable insights, accelerates delivery, and expands access to trusted information across the organization. You will lead the development of modern analytics capabilities, establish consistent data definitions and governance standards, and enable business users and AI tools to access and interpret data reliably. By connecting analytics strategy with business priorities, you will help ensure that data-driven insights are timely, consistent, and accessible to the people and systems that depend on them.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and develop a phased roadmap for business intelligence, analytics, data science, and AI-assisted analysis aligned with W&D's strategic priorities.
  • Establish an operating model for partnering with business lines to identify needs, prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver high-value analytics solutions.
  • Define and maintain standards for analytical quality, key performance indicators (KPIs), business metrics, and reporting consistency across the organization.
  • Improve the speed and quality of analytics delivery by establishing performance targets, measuring results, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the development and delivery of business intelligence solutions, advanced analytics, and predictive models that support decision-making across capital markets, credit risk, servicing, sales, and other business functions.
  • Lead the modernization of reporting and analytics capabilities, transitioning legacy reporting to scalable, governed business intelligence solutions.
  • Enable business users to conduct AI-assisted analysis using governed data, with clear standards for accuracy, reliability, and appropriate use.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and AI Enablement teams to integrate data and analytics into business workflows, providing the datasets, metrics, and analytical capabilities needed to support implementation and measure results.
  • Establish practices for testing, validating, and monitoring analytical and machine learning models, while maintaining standards for data quality, governance, and access.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of shared business definitions, metrics, and semantic frameworks to ensure consistent interpretation of data across reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
  • Make trusted business context and data definitions accessible to analysts, business users, and AI tools to support consistent and reliable analytical results.
  • Partner with AI Enablement, Data Engineering, and Product leaders to maintain the data structures, knowledge resources, and retrieval approaches needed to support AI-assisted analysis.
  • Expand shared data definitions and analytical capabilities based on business priorities, established reporting needs, and evolving demand.
  • Lead, coach, and develop analytics and data science leaders and their teams, establishing hiring and development plans aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Provide technical direction and oversight by reviewing analytical models, queries, dashboards, and methodologies to ensure quality and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product leaders to maintain reliable shared datasets, establish service expectations, and support the data infrastructure required for analytics and AI applications.
  • Communicate analytics strategy, progress, performance, and business outcomes to executive leadership and key stakeholders in clear, actionable business terms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required; master's degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, applied data science, or a related field, including at least 7 years of experience leading multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing analytics strategies aligned with business priorities and measurable organizational outcomes.
  • Proven ability to improve analytics delivery, operational efficiency, and analytical quality.
  • Experience implementing machine learning models, predictive analytics, and AI-assisted analysis in production environments.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing analytics and data science teams.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and cloud analytical databases such as Amazon Redshift or Snowflake.
  • Experience in commercial real estate, financial services, or capital markets preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, machine learning, and data modeling, with the ability to evaluate analytical quality and provide technical direction.
  • Working knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, as well as SQL and Python.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI analysis tools, their applications, and responsible practices for implementation and use.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, access controls, and analytical standards.
  • Understanding of semantic layers, metric definitions, and business context required to support consistent reporting and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable analytics initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and technical trade-offs to executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Strong leadership and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build partnerships, and collaborate across business functions.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with technical oversight, operational priorities, and timely execution.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a results-oriented approach and commitment to delivering measurable business value.
  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

This position has an estimated base salary of $220,000 - $260,000 plus a discretionary bonus and stock compensation. An employment offer is based on the applicant’s relevant work experience, applicable knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

What We Offer 

  • The opportunity to join one of Fortune Magazine’s Great Places to Work winners

  • Comprehensive benefit options* that have earned Walker & Dunlop the gold level of the 2025 Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation™, some of which include:
    - Up to 83% subsidized medical payroll deductions

    - Company-paid life, short and long-term disability insurance
    - Health Savings Account and Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending

  • Career development opportunities

  • Empowerment and encouragement to give back – volunteer hours and donation matching

*Eligibility may vary based on average number of hours worked

data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

  • Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

  • Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.title: Data Warehouse & Analytics Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Responsible for developing and maintaining the trusted data foundation that supports technology performance reporting, operational and risk metrics, analytics, and operational insights. This role acquires, transforms, structures, and maintains data from multiple sources to enable consistent, scalable, and automated reporting and analytical solutions. The position also designs and supports an interim analytics data repository to meet current business needs while partnering with enterprise data teams and preparing for transition to long-term enterprise data solutions.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities

System Enhancement & Data Warehouse Support

  • Evaluates, enhances, and maintains technology performance data warehouse solutions, reporting capabilities, and analytics platforms.
  • Develops and supports data structures, processes, and applications that improve access to technology performance metrics and operational insights.
  • Designs, develops, tests, and implements enhancements that align with existing system architecture and enterprise technology standards.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve solution performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.

Data Ingestion & Source Integration

  • Develops and maintains data ingestion processes that integrate information from technology platforms, operational systems, vendor applications, and other internal and external data sources.
  • Supports source-to-target mappings, data integration requirements, and data movement processes.
  • Develops and maintains interfaces utilizing APIs, database connectivity, and file-based integrations to ensure efficient and reliable data acquisition.
  • Collaborates with business and technology stakeholders to identify new data requirements and integration opportunities.

Data Transformation & Curation

  • Develops and maintains ETL/ELT processes that transform source data into trusted analytics-ready datasets.
  • Applies business rules, data validations, standardization processes, and transformation logic to support reporting and analytical requirements.
  • Ensures data consistency, accuracy, usability, and alignment with established business definitions and reporting standards.

Analytics Data Modeling

  • Designs, develops, and maintains analytical and dimensional data models that support technology performance management, reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI measurement.
  • Supports reporting and analytics initiatives through the development of optimized data structures and reporting datasets.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective analytical data solutions.

Historical Data & Snapshot Management

  • Maintains historical data repositories and snapshot methodologies to support trend analysis, forecasting, benchmarking, audit requirements, and long-term performance measurement.
  • Ensures historical data structures support consistent reporting and analysis across reporting periods.
  • Implements processes that preserve data lineage and historical integrity.

Data Quality Controls

  • Develops and maintains data quality controls, validation procedures, reconciliation processes, and monitoring solutions.
  • Identifies, researches, and resolves data integrity issues, anomalies, and discrepancies.
  • Partners with source system owners and stakeholders to improve data quality and ensure confidence in reporting outputs.
  • Supports data governance, documentation, and compliance requirements where applicable.

Business Support & Operational Excellence

  • Provides technical support to production data warehouse and analytics environments by addressing complex issues, anticipating maintenance requirements, and ensuring ongoing functionality.
  • Monitors data processes, data flows, and scheduled jobs to ensure timely and accurate delivery of information.
  • Performs root cause analysis and implements corrective actions to improve system stability and performance.
  • Develops technical solutions to unique business and system challenges.
  • Leads major projects, delegates tasks as appropriate, and ensures quality outcomes.

Data Process Automation

  • Develops and implements automation solutions for data processing, validation, monitoring, reporting, and operational support activities.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and enhance process reliability.
  • Supports CI/CD and deployment automation practices where appropriate.

Technical Documentation & Maintainability

  • Creates and maintains technical documentation including data mappings, process flows, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, support documentation, and implementation plans.
  • Ensures solutions are maintainable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise development standards and best practices.
  • Reviews business specifications, technical designs, coding standards, testing plans, and implementation documentation for accuracy and completeness.

Planning & Team Ceremonies

  • Participates in Agile planning activities, sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, work estimation, and project execution activities.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to prioritize work and align solutions with business objectives.
  • Provides technical leadership and guidance during project planning and delivery efforts.

Technical Expertise

  • Utilizes expertise to mentor and train associates within the work group.
  • Serves as a technical resource for management, associates, and business partners.
  • Participates in special projects and meetings as needed to provide technical insight and recommendations.
  • Promotes best practices related to data management, reporting, analytics, software development, and operational support.

Data Analysis

  • Collects and analyzes data related to user requests and business requirements to determine scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and system impacts.
  • Evaluates business and technical requirements to develop effective data and reporting solutions.
  • Reviews specifications, coding, test plans, documentation, and implementation activities to ensure quality and alignment with business needs.

Required Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL development, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Oracle database technologies and data warehouse environments.
  • Advanced experience with ETL/ELT development and support.
  • Advanced experience with Python or similar programming language used for automation, orchestration, and data engineering solutions.
  • Experience with data ingestion, source integration, and API-based data acquisition.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Experience developing and maintaining analytics-focused and dimensional data models.
  • Experience supporting historical data management and snapshot-based reporting.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, reconciliations, and validation processes.
  • Experience with pipeline orchestration and automated workflow management.
  • Experience with cloud-based data technologies, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring, troubleshooting, observability, and production support processes.
  • Advanced experience with Git or similar source code repository systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes and deployment automation.
  • Advanced experience with Jira, ServiceNow, or similar work management and support platforms.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
  • Proven ability to drive consensus among cross-functional roles, resolve conflicting situations, and drive effective business and technical outcomes.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call support rotation as needed.

Education

Bachelor's Degree and 6 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 10 years' experience

Work Experience

data.title: Senior Data Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions

data.description:
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates (“LendingTree”) will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.

The Opportunity
As a Data Engineer at LendingTree, you’ll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You’ll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Build and operate scalable batch and real-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery.
  • Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities.
  • Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence.
  • Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials.
  • Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade-offs, and delivery estimates.
  • Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You’ll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems.
  • Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns.
  • Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented.
  • Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions.
  • Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards.

What Will Help You Thrive
You’re curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus:

  • Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server.
  • Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation.
  • Python, C#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit for dashboards, data applications, and communicating insights.
  • using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Maia to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated code and results.
  • S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Production pipelines meet agreed freshness and reliability targets, with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
  • Business, analytics, and data science partners use tested models with consistent definitions and less manual reconciliation.
  • Query tuning and pipeline improvements produce measurable reductions in runtime, compute cost, or recurring incidents.
  • Reusable frameworks, useful documentation, and validated AI workflows shorten delivery time while maintaining quality.

Life at LendingTree

We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that’s curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You’ll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed.

We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You’ll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together.

And while we work hard, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way.

Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what’s next.

What We Offer

We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous time off
  • Wellness programs and resources
  • Annual performance bonus eligibility

Base Pay:

The base pay range for this position is $100,000-130,000; pay offered may vary based on location, internal factors, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Incentive Compensation: This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus.

Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment.

Everyone Belongs Here

LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status.

If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com.

Degreed is the leading enterprise learning system for workforce transformation, bringing together everything people need to learn and advance: courses, videos, articles, projects, and real-world skill insights, matched to individual roles, skills, and goals.

For businesses, Degreed builds the infrastructure for a culture of learning that attracts, develops, and retains top talent, driving performance at scale. Named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 — alongside Google, Nvidia, and Adidas — Degreed is recognized for its AI-driven approach to closing the human readiness gap and turning learning ambition into measurable impact.

We believe learning is the key to unlocking opportunity, and our mission is to discover, empower, and celebrate the next generation of global expertise. Join us in shaping the future of learning and workforce development!

About the Role

Degreed is hiring a Senior Revenue Intelligence Analyst to own and drive a unified GTM data strategy supporting pre-sales, post-sales, and leadership with analytics and insights to run the business. This is an individual contributor role inside the global revenue operations team, reporting to the head of RevOps. It comes with regular visibility with senior leaders and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact for cross-functional teams.

In this role, you’ll drive revenue intelligence and insights with an AI-forward approach, enhancing business outcomes like retention and new ARR and improving our measurement of marketing ROI, forecasting accuracy, and predictive churn signals. You’ll own and build the dashboards and reporting behind important GTM decisions using our newly implemented BI tool (Hex), and tying data and performance back to pipeline, revenue, and retention. You’ll work with product and engineering to keep warehouse data clean and help validate the commercial data underneath it all, including ARR, quotes, order forms, and renewals.

Revenue Operations is a highly collaborative, positive team - we value new points of view, share our expertise, ask for help when we need it, and support each other to get the job done. Degreed is also changing how this function works with AI, from documentation to agents, and you’ll play an impactful role in how revenue operations continue to evolve with AI.

Key Skills

  • SQL and BI dashboarding: read and write SQL, and build BI dashboards that sales, marketing, and leadership use in regular decisions.
  • Revenue analytics: trace pipeline from top-of-funnel marketing through closed revenue, find where it falls out of the funnel, and explain what the numbers do and don’t show.
  • Executive communication: present analysis to senior leaders, and explain the numbers when they’re challenged.
  • Stakeholder ownership: run conversations with sales, marketing, and finance leaders on your own, without needing direction at each step.
  • Commercial data validation: check ARR, net new ACV, prorated terms, FX adjustments, and quote-to-order form alignment, and flag errors before they reach finance.
  • Data quality: judge whether warehouse views are clean and validated, and work with engineering to fix them when they aren’t.
  • Tool selection: decide when a report or dashboard belongs in Claude, Salesforce, or Hex, and explain the tradeoff.
  • Requirements translation: turn a business need into technical requirements that field operations, system architects, and engineers can build from.
  • Financial fluency: leverage strong working knowledge of revenue recognition principles, gross/net revenue retention (GRR/NRR), forecasting, and CPQ logic.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools and technologies: use AI (e.g. Claude, Gemini, CoPilot) as a partner in your daily work to accelerate QA, contribute to AI-ready documentation, expand our GTM context layer, and automate recurring work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM data strategy across pre-sales and post-sales motions, so every team works from the same definitions and the same numbers.
  • Build the business-level dashboards, forecasts, and analyses that track pipeline from top-of-funnel marketing through closed revenue, and tie numbers back to top line financial metrics.
  • Own executive and board-level reporting for quarterly business reviews, and validate every figure before it goes out.
  • Build forecasts and function-specific reporting for marketing, sales, and services, and refine the assumptions behind them as results come in.
  • Improve our ability to surface early risk signals in new ARR, retention and churn.
  • Manage and prioritize reporting and dashboard requests from stakeholders inside or outside revenue (e.g. finance)
  • Build new views and datasets to meet business requirements. Partner with engineering to keep warehouse views clean and engage their resources when more complex support is needed.
  • Turn analysis into plain-language recommendations for leadership.
  • Validate commercial data that affects sales and finance reporting and forecasting, including ARR, net new ACV, prorated terms, FX adjustments, quote-to-order form alignment, and renewal details such as subscriptions, renewal values, and off-cycle changes.
  • Build AI-ready documentation, context, and data architecture for the team, and build agents that other people use.

Compensation

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The total pay range for this role is $130.000 - $150.000.
Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, depth of experience, certifications, specific work location, and internal equity.

Benefits

We take care of our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and success.

View full details →

At Degreed, We Value

🔷 Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate diverse perspectives and backgrounds, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and contribute.
🔷 Growth Mindset – Learning is at the heart of what we do. We empower our employees to continuously develop their skills and grow their careers in alignment with their unique strengths and aspirations.
🔷 Collaboration – The best ideas come from working together. We cultivate a culture of open communication, teamwork, and shared success.

By joining Degreed, you’ll be part of a community that values learning, collaboration, and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about driving change through upskilling and workforce transformation, we encourage you to apply and contribute to our mission.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

Degreed offers flexible work arrangements tailored to each role. Some positions are fully remote, while others follow a hybrid model for employees near an office. Please check the job details for role-specific requirements.
For remote and hybrid roles, you’ll collaborate virtually using tools like Zoom and Slack. This role may require prolonged computer use and stationary work, with the ability to interpret written and verbal communication effectively.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and adaptable work environment that enables every team member to thrive and do their best work.

Additional Information

Degreed is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, career development, compensation, and training.

🔷 Accessibility & Accommodations – We are dedicated to full inclusion and will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance, please let us know.
🔷 Fair Hiring Practices – In compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
🔷 E-Verify Participation – Degreed participates in the E-Verify employment verification program.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Applicants

When you apply, Degreed, Inc. collects and processes the personal data in your application (such as your CV, contact details, and answers to our questions) to evaluate your candidacy. We will keep your application data for 60 days after the recruitment process for this role is completed. After this period, your data will be deleted, unless we are required by law to keep it. data.title: Head of AI, Automation & Analytics
data.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

UpGuard is seeking a Head of AI & Automation to lead A2, our central function for AI, workflow automation and analytics within the Operations department. You will lead a small team of a Lead AI & Automation Analyst and two AI & Automation Engineers, and work closely with the AI & Automation Enablement Lead in our People team.

You will set UpGuard's automation and AI strategy, decide what gets built, and make sure the AI agents and automated business processes the team delivers run on secure, reliable and well-governed platforms. Where a team can automate its own work, you give it the tools, standards and coaching to do so. Where the work spans several teams or is too complex for one team to build, your team delivers it directly.

What will you accomplish?

  • Set A2's charter, operating model and rolling 6-month strategy, aligned with priorities from the Chief Operating Officer and the Steering Committee (SteerCo)

  • Define quarterly OKRs for the function and report progress to SteerCo and the Executive Committee (ExCo)

  • Decide which processes to automate and which AI capabilities to build, based on business impact, time saved and risk

  • Own the roadmap for ug-buddy, UpGuard's internal AI co-worker, which connects company knowledge, data and tools through a single interface

  • Lead, coach and performance-manage the A2 team, design its structure and roles, and recruit new team members

  • Run the team's delivery process: fortnightly sprints, prioritisation, and a capacity model that balances project work, automation requests, team improvement and buffer

  • Set the technical direction and architecture for AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP integrations and workflow automation

  • Review designs and production readiness of the systems the team builds on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, GKE) and n8n

  • Deliver cross-functional automations that no single team owns, such as employee offboarding across identity, collaboration and HR systems

  • Set the standards every production automation must meet (ownership, error alerting, enforced linting, documentation and least-privilege access), audit the platform against them and drive remediation

  • Work with Cloud Platform Engineering and Security on hosting, access control and incident response for A2 systems

  • Perform the AI risk review in UpGuard's vendor procurement process, assessing each vendor's AI use, data handling and contract terms

  • Own A2's tooling and vendor relationships, including n8n, AI model providers and Google Cloud AI services

  • Act as the single point of contact for AI, automation and analytics requests, through one intake channel where every request gets an owner

  • Work with department heads to map how their processes run and agree on what A2 will build or enable

  • Make A2's services understood across the company through documentation, communication and training, together with the Enablement Lead

How will success be measured?

  • Quarterly OKRs delivered and reported to SteerCo

  • Effort saved by shipped automations, in hours and dollars

  • Adoption of A2 tools across the company, including the automation platform and the AI co-worker

  • Every internal request has an owner, with none bounced

  • Reliability of production automations: success rate, and failures caught by alerting rather than reported by users

  • Share of the organisation that can say what A3 does and how to reach it (survey)

How is the time split?

  • Strategy, planning and executive stakeholder management: ~20%

  • Team leadership, coaching and recruitment: ~25%

  • Technical direction, architecture and design review: ~25%

  • Platform standards, AI governance and vendor management: ~10%

Who will you work with?

Company Overview: AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director, Strategic Pricing & Analytics serves as a key business partner to Health Plan Relations (HPR), Revenue Cycle Management, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership, leading the organization's payer contract modeling, chargemaster governance, and price transparency analytics functions. This role provides financial and operational insights that support payer negotiations, pricing decisions, reimbursement optimization, and integration activities. The Director is responsible for establishing analytical standards, ensuring data integrity, developing team capabilities, and advancing the organization's pricing and reimbursement analytics programs.

Work Schedule: Remote First

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead payer contract modeling activities, directing the development, maintenance, and governance of reimbursement models while ensuring consistency, accuracy, scalability, and actionable insights across all markets and service lines.
  • Serve as a player-coach by remaining actively engaged in complex reimbursement modeling, financial analysis, and payer negotiation support while mentoring and developing team members in modeling methodologies and analytical best practices.
  • Direct chargemaster development, maintenance, and pricing governance to support revenue integrity, compliance, and reimbursement optimization.
  • Partner with departmental leadership to develop and enhance price transparency reporting, dashboards, and market intelligence capabilities.
  • Oversee the aggregation, validation, and interpretation of pricing and reimbursement data to support payer negotiations, market assessments, and executive decision-making.
  • Lead and direct analytics staff to meet business needs that support achieving department and organizational goals and objectives.
  • Establish and maintain standards, controls, and governance processes that ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of payer modeling, reimbursement analytics, chargemaster management, and price transparency reporting.
  • Represent HPR on integration committees associated with acquisitions, de novo centers, mergers, and center consolidations, providing reimbursement, pricing, chargemaster, and payer contract expertise to support successful integrations.
  • Lead ad hoc reimbursement analyses and other analytical projects requested by leadership to support business planning and operational initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement through talent development, process optimization, reporting enhancements, and advancement of analytical tools and technologies.

data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Risk Automation & Intelligence leads the strategy and execution of the data, analytics and automation capabilities that the rest of the Technology Risk and Compliance function relies on to manage risk and demonstrate compliance effectively and efficiently. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK, spanning policy, process, automation and tooling, training and end-user experience for Technology Risk and Compliance capabilities and services.

About the team. Risk Automation and Intelligence is the engine room of the Risk and Compliance function's data and automation, operating as GSK's Risk Operations Centre. The team builds future-ready analytics, automation and intelligence that enable GSK to manage technology risk and compliance proactively and at scale.

Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Set the enterprise vision and multi-year strategy for the data, analytics and automation capabilities that underpin Technology Risk and Compliance at GSK, and secure the investment to deliver it.
  • Lead the Risk Automation & Intelligence organisation, including leaders of teams, and own its capability plan.
  • Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
  • Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators.
  • Own GSK's Cyber Security Policies, ensuring they remain current, practical and aligned with the evolving threat, technology and regulatory landscape.
  • Own the Technology Risk and Compliance processes used across GSK, ensuring they are well-designed, consistently applied and continuously improved.
  • Own the integration between Technology Risk and Compliance and GSK's Enterprise Risk Programme, ensuring technology risk is represented accurately and consistently in enterprise risk reporting and governance.
  • Operate and evolve GSK's Risk Operations Centre model, bringing modern Risk Operations Centre concepts, continuous controls monitoring and quantitative risk analysis into how GSK manages technology risk and compliance.
  • Bring product management rigour to the roadmap for risk and compliance tooling, translating the needs of stakeholders at Director, VP and SVP level into prioritised features and releases.
  • Build and lead the capability that automates risk, control and compliance processes, including AI and intelligent automation, to replace manual effort with proactive, at-scale risk management.
  • Develop risk analytics, models and quantitative risk methods that help the business identify, evaluate and treat cyber risk, and that support prioritisation and inform resource and investment decisions for leadership, ExCom and the Board.
  • Develop performance analytics that measure the effectiveness and operational efficiency of the Technology Risk and Compliance programme itself, driving continuous improvement.

data.title: Senior Analytics Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role

data.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to build the data models that teams across Instructure use to run the business. You'll work in dbt and Snowflake every day. You'll also sit in the room with business leaders, understand the decisions they're making, and design data that answers their questions correctly the first time.

This role is broad by design. You'll support analytics across Finance, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and other parts of the company, so you'll see how the whole business fits together. It suits someone who writes clean SQL and also asks "what is this number used for?" before building it. You'll own models from source to dashboard, and you'll help set the standards for how we design, test, and document our data.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain dimensional models in dbt and Snowflake that support reporting and analysis across Finance, Operations, Product Management, and other business functions.

  • Translate business questions into clear data requirements by working directly with senior leaders across the company.

  • Own the full model lifecycle: source ingestion patterns, staging, intermediate and mart layers, tests, documentation, and deployment.

  • Set and enforce modeling standards, including naming conventions, grain definitions, slowly changing dimension handling, and testing practices.

  • Tune Snowflake performance and cost through smart materialization choices, clustering, and warehouse sizing.

  • Partner with data engineers and business systems teams to make sure upstream data arrives in a shape we can model well.

  • Review pull requests, mentor analysts and engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team.

  • Explain data definitions and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences in plain language, and push back when a request would produce a misleading metric.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or another quantitative field is preferred.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with dbt, including macros, packages, incremental models, snapshots, and testing.

  • Strong Snowflake skills, with advanced SQL and a good sense of performance and cost.

  • Proven experience designing dimensional models (star schemas, facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions) and a clear point of view on when to use them and when not to.

  • Solid data architecture instincts: layered modeling, grain, lineage, data contracts, and maintainable project structure.

  • Working knowledge of how a business operates across functions such as finance, sales, operations, and product, ideally in a SaaS company.

  • The ability to hold a credible conversation with directors, VPs, and executives about business issues, and to turn that conversation into a data solution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You document your work and explain it well.

  • Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data projects.

Nice to have

  • Experience modeling data from CRM and other business systems such as Salesforce.

  • Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt Cloud.

  • Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.

  • Background in a SaaS or education technology company.

What success looks like

  • In 90 days, you've shipped your first production models and built working relationships with partners in several business functions.

  • In 6 months, you own a major domain in our data model and the business trusts the numbers it produces.

  • In a year, you've shaped our modeling standards and made the whole team faster.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.
